# Report of the Board of Commissioners

![img-6.jpeg](img-6.jpeg)

Dear Fellow Shareholders,
Kepada Para Pemegang Saham yang Terhormat,

We are excited and ready for the future, inspired by our 77-year proud history.

That history is not only made by strong financial performance. It is made by our culture and how our values are embedded in the purpose of holding the care of human life as our highest priority and thereby glorify God. We remain acutely aware of and humbled by our responsibility to shareholders, patients, customers, and society. And we recognize that our team still, and always, strives for results.

The success of SOHO Global Health is built on being true to our purpose and living our values to deliver for people, society, and the planet. Our success is built on relentlessly pushing the boundaries to be a healthcare leader and the preeminent provider of innovative natural pharmaceutical products, as reflected in our vision statement.

2023 in review

In 2023, SOHO Global Health closed the year with a Net Profit After Tax of IDR 371.34 billion from IDR 357.01 billion in 2022, a 4.0% increase compared to a year earlier.

With regard to our dividend, the Company has distributed Interim Dividend for Financial Year 2023 to the Shareholders based on the Circular Resolution In Lieu of the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners' Meeting of PT Soho Global Health Tbk dated October 31, 2023, with a total amount of IDR 250,026,143,083 (IDR 197,- per share), which was fully paid on November 27, 2023.

Innovation to drive our vision forward

At SOHO Global Health, we recognize the importance of innovation as a driver of growth across all our businesses. Our strategy in driving our vision forward focuses on maximizing our efficiency and efficacy so we can reach as many patients/customers as possible. We streamlined our processes, enabling us to deliver breakthroughs more quickly without compromising quality.

Important new product innovations like Imboost Extra with vitamin C and D (2021), Imboost Bone (2022), and Imboost/Imboost Force Cough (2023) helped to build a much higher base compared to the pre-pandemic period, as we expanded our portfolio to ensure that we are meeting the needs of different patient populations and addressing unmet patient needs.

Our innovation strategy is to complement in-house innovation with external collaborations to deliver greater long-term value for our patients and the Company. We have established business collaborations with several companies, including SOHO Flordis International, our sister company with a global sales and marketing network. We also collaborate with partners in academia, other businesses, government institutions, and the wider community through our "open innovation" concept in R&D efforts.

Kami sangat antusias dan siap menghadapi masa depan, terinspirasi oleh sejarah membanggakan kami selama 77 tahun.

Sejarah tersebut tidak hanya diciptakan oleh kinerja keuangan yang kuat. Sejarah itu diciptakan oleh budaya kami dan bagaimana nilai-nilai kami tertanam dalam tujuan menjunjung kepedulian terhadap kehidupan manusia sebagai prioritas kami yang tertinggi untuk memuliakan Tuhan Yang Maha Esa. Kami tetap sangat sadar dan rendah hati akan tanggung jawab kami kepada para pemegang saham, pasien, pelanggan, dan masyarakat. Dan kami mengakui bahwa tim kami masih, dan selalu, berusaha untuk mencapai hasil yang terbaik.

Keberhasilan SOHO Global Health dibangun dengan tetap setia pada tujuan kami dan bagaimana kami menghidupi nilai-nilai kami untuk memberikan manfaat bagi banyak orang, masyarakat, dan planet ini. Keberhasilan kami dibangun dengan terus-menerus mendorong batas-batas untuk menjadi pemimpin di bidang layanan kesehatan dan penyedia terkemuka untuk produk-produk farmasi berbahan alami inovatif, seperti yang tercermin dalam pernyataan visi kami.

Kajian Kinerja 2023

Pada tahun 2023, SOHO Global Health menutup tahun dengan Laba Bersih Setelah Pajak sebesar Rp 371,34 miliar dari Rp 357,01 miliar pada tahun 2022, atau meningkat sebesar 4,0% dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya.

Sehubungan dengan dividen, Perusahaan telah mendistribusikan Dividen Interim untuk Tahun Keuangan 2023 kepada para Pemegang Saham berdasarkan Keputusan Sirkuler Pengganti Rapat Direksi dan Rapat Komisaris PT Soho Global Health Tbk tertanggal 31 Oktober 2023, dengan total jumlah dividen sebesar Rp 250.026.143.083 (Rp 197,- per saham), yang telah dibayarkan penuh pada tanggal 27 November 2023.

Inovasi untuk mendorong pencapaian visi kami

Di SOHO Global Health, kami mengakui pentingnya inovasi sebagai pendorong pertumbuhan di semua lini bisnis kami. Strategi kami dalam mendorong pencapaian visi kami berfokus pada upaya kami memaksimalkan efisiensi dan efektivitas kami sehingga kami dapat menjangkau sebanyak mungkin pasien/pelanggan. Kami menyederhanakan proses operasional kami, yang memungkinkan kami menciptakan terobosan lebih cepat tanpa mengorbankan kualitas.

Inovasi produk penting seperti Imboost Extra dengan vitamin C dan D (2021), Imboost Bone (2022), dan Imboost/Imboost Force Cough (2023) telah membantu membangun dasar yang jauh lebih kuat dibandingkan dengan periode sebelum pandemi, karena kami memperluas portofolio kami untuk memastikan bahwa kami memenuhi kebutuhan berbagai populasi pasien dan menjawab kebutuhan pasien yang belum terpenuhi.

Strategi inovasi kami adalah melengkapi inovasi internal dengan kolaborasi eksternal untuk memberikan nilai jangka panjang yang lebih besar bagi pasien dan Perusahaan kami. Kami telah menjalin kerja sama bisnis dengan beberapa perusahaan, termasuk SOHO Flordis International, perusahaan afiliasi kami yang memiliki jaringan penjualan dan pemasaran global. Kami juga berkolaborasi dengan mitra di akademisi, pelaku bisnis lainnya, lembaga pemerintah, dan masyarakat luas melalui konsep "inovasi terbuka" dalam upaya R&D kami.

In the past four years, we have focused on a Digital Transformation that proved to be very helpful during the pandemic and continued in the post-pandemic. Today, "PPGOS," which stands for PPG Online System, is one of the innovations introduced by PPG to maintain its lead in the digital era by offering convenience in placing orders online to its B2B customers. Since the nationwide launch in November 2019, progress has been very positive, with over 25,000 customers registered at the end of December 2023 and a 40% sales contribution from related channels.

We have also systematically implemented our sustainability strategy over the past years, and we remain on track to achieve our ambitious targets. One of the highlights in 2023 was the inauguration for the Solar Cell System Project installation between PT Soho Global Health and PT Ditrolic ATW Energi as the project partner, in October 2023. Having implemented solar system in its SIP manufacturing facility and PPG warehouse, SOHO expected to contribute a positive impact on the environment and its sustainability in reducing the problem of climate change and global warming.

All these advances in innovation and sustainability show what our company is capable of. And we are still hitting our stride. We will make every effort to realize this potential in full. We remain focused on our Purpose and Vision, and we are committed to bringing our purpose to life. We have set ourselves ambitious targets to make sure that SOHO Global Health is a faster, better, and more innovative company in the future, for the benefit of our shareholders and patients/customers we serve.

We are grateful for our employees, business partners, patients, customers, and the support of the communities in which we operate. Thank you for being a part of our journey.

# Dear Fellow Shareholders,

## Kepada Para Pemegang Saham yang Terhormat,

While 2023 was a year of several challenges, it was also a year of significant accomplishments. A year that we believe sets up our company for renewed innovation and progress in 2024 and beyond.

We are encouraged by the strong performance of our distribution business in 2023, including significant contributions from new principals and robust year-over-year growth for several existing principals.

In terms of challenges, the hard truth is that we missed our initial projections for our proprietary products, largely due to the decline in sales of our immune-boosting products post COVID-19 pandemic.

We took corrective steps. We reduced inventories of our overstock products to reflect anticipated future demand; we improved our commercial structure; we expanded our portfolio to help ensure that we are meeting the needs of different patient/ customer populations and addressing unmet patient/ customer needs; and we continued our cost-realignment program to right-size our cost base. Difficult, but necessary, decisions were made, enabling us to be more efficient and effective. I am proud that we met our challenges with courage, compassion, and renewed commitment to our purpose.

As a result of our corrective actions, we are entering 2024 with a solid foundation. We believe our commitment to execution, securing new distribution principals, maximizing the performance of our key brands, and delivering the next wave of pipeline innovation will fuel SOHO's growth and make a difference in the lives of patients and customers everywhere.

Looking further forward, we will continue to take advantage of the opportunities provided by the Indonesian healthcare market. We engage closely with the consumer, healthcare professionals, government, and academic sectors, among others, to launch new products and multiple initiatives and projects that support our business objective, purpose, and vision.

## An extraordinary year of innovation and impact

SOHO Global Health is successfully navigating the challenges we face by consistently pursuing our long-term strategy. We are introducing innovative products and purposefully advancing our digital transformation to remain at the forefront of our industry. We conduct our business with a focus on Creating Shared Value, prioritizing the creation of value for both our shareholders and society. This approach has been fundamental to our company's success, and we remain committed to making a positive difference to society through our activities and products.

Meskipun tahun 2023 merupakan tahun yang penuh dengan berbagai tantangan, namun juga merupakan tahun yang penuh dengan pencapaian yang signifikan. Tahun yang kami yakini telah menyiapkan perusahaan untuk inovasi dan kemajuan yang berkelanjutan di sepanjang 2024 dan seterusnya.

Kami sangat termotivasi oleh performa andal dari bisnis distribusi kami pada tahun 2023, termasuk kontribusi signifikan dari prinsip-prinsip baru dan pertumbuhan yang kuat dari beberapa prinsip existing yang konsisten bertumbuh dari tahun ke tahun.

Dalam hal tantangan, kenyataan yang sulit dihadapi adalah bahwa kami tidak berhasil mencapai proyeksi awal penjualan untuk produk-produk unggulan kami, yang sebagian besar disebabkan oleh penurunan penjualan produk-produk peningkat kekebalan tubuh kami setelah pandemi COVID-19 berlalu.

Kami mengambil langkah-langkah korektif. Kami mengurangi tingkat persediaan atas produk-produk kami yang kelebihan stok untuk mengantisipasi permintaan selanjutnya yang mungkin akan terkoreksi; kami memperbaiki struktur komersial kami; kami memperluas portofolio kami untuk memastikan bahwa kami memenuhi kebutuhan berbagai populasi pasien/pelanggan dan menjawab kebutuhan pasien/pelanggan yang belum terpenuhi; dan kami melanjutkan program penyesuaian biaya kami untuk menyesuaikan ukuran basis biaya kami. Pilihan yang sulit, namun perlu untuk kami lakukan, keputusan yang telah kami buat pada akhirnya memungkinkan kami beroperasi lebih efisien dan efektif. Saya bangga bahwa kami menghadapi tantangan yang ada dengan keberanian, tekad, dan komitmen baru terhadap tujuan kami.

Sebagai hasil dari tindakan korektif yang kami lakukan, kami memasuki tahun 2024 dengan pondasi yang kokoh. Kami percaya bahwa komitmen kami terhadap eksekusi strategi, upaya mendapatkan prinsip baru untuk bisnis distribusi kami, upaya memaksimalkan kinerja merek-merek utama kami, dan upaya menghadirkan inovasi yang terus berkesinambungan akan memperkuat pertumbuhan SOHO dan membuat perbedaan dalam kehidupan pasien dan pelanggan di manapun.

Ke depannya, kami akan terus memanfaatkan peluang yang disediakan oleh pasar perawatan kesehatan di Indonesia. Kami terus membangun interaksi yang dekat dengan konsumen, profesional kesehatan, pemerintah, dan sektor akademis, diantaranya, untuk mendukung peluncuran produk-produk baru kami dan beberapa inisiatif serta proyek yang mendukung tujuan bisnis dan visi kami.

## Tahun yang luar biasa dalam hal inovasi dan dampak

SOHO Global Health berhasil menavigasi tantangan yang dihadapi dengan konsisten mengejar strategi jangka panjang. Kami memperkenalkan produk-produk inovatif dan fokus memajukan transformasi digital untuk tetap menjadi yang terdepan di industri kesehatan. Kami menjalankan bisnis kami dengan fokus pada Penciptaan Nilai Bersama, memprioritaskan penciptaan nilai bagi pemegang saham dan masyarakat. Pendekatan ini telah menjadi dasar kesuksesan perusahaan kami, dan kami tetap berkomitmen untuk memberikan dampak positif bagi masyarakat melalui kegiatan dan produk kami.

We are pleased with the strong execution to deliver several key initiatives in commercial aspects and sustainability commitments. We are prepared to execute our commercial strategy to drive continued growth from our newly launched and existing core products, and to deliver on our targeted cost savings that we expect will expand our operating margins in 2024 and beyond.

As our business continues to grow, so does our role in society. The burden of global serious chronic diseases and the impact of air pollution in Jakarta and its surrounding areas have brought about health and social repercussions and demand innovative solutions that are as sustainable as they are impactful. Our core contribution to this fight remains our industry-leading therapeutic innovations, with the launch of Imboost Cough and Imboost Force Cough, among others, which benefited people in Indonesia. Yet we are also increasingly focused on prevention as we seek to understand and address the root causes of the diseases we treat.

## 2023 Performance in review

2022/23 were the post-Covid years following the pandemic that swept the world in 2020-21. For SOHO Global Health, these were challenging years, and although sales of our proprietary products, especially Imboost, were significantly affected, the Imboost equity continued to grow market share.

Despite these challenging business conditions, we are steadily making progress to better position our key businesses for the future. Our 2023 net sales grew by 12.5% compared to the previous year. However, it is important to acknowledge that this growth was primarily due to strong sales from third-party principals. Parit Pading Global (PPG), our distribution business, saw a net revenue increase of 18.9% in total compared to the previous year. Sales of our proprietary products, including both the Professional Products and Consumer Health divisions, collectively decreased by -13.8%. This was largely due to the significant slowdown of Imboost sales post-COVID and issues with national syrup regulations that persisted until H1 2023.

Looking back at the past year, we have much to be proud of. According to the latest IQVIA data for MAT Q4 2023, SOHO Global Health continues to be among the top 20 healthcare companies in Indonesia, the top 5 OTC companies, and the top 5 Vitamin companies. Imboost also remains among the top 5 largest pharmaceutical brands/products in Indonesia. These are strong milestones, and we should continue working hard to deliver success for SOHO Global Health. Furthermore, we have a robust pipeline of product innovation for 2024 and beyond, and a cash-rich balance sheet to complement organic growth with any inorganic opportunities that may arise.

Kami bangga dengan eksekusi andal yang menghasilkan performa unggul beberapa inisiatif kunci dalam aspek komersial dan komitmen keberlanjutan kami. Kami siap untuk mengeksekusi strategi komersial kami untuk mendorong pertumbuhan berkelanjutan dari produk kami yang baru diluncurkan dan yang sudah ada, serta untuk mencapai penghematan biaya yang ditargetkan yang kami harapkan akan memperluas margin operasional kami pada tahun 2024 dan seterusnya.

Seiring dengan pertumbuhan bisnis kami, peran kami dalam masyarakat juga berkembang. Beban penyakit kronis serius global dan dampak polusi udara di Jakarta dan sekitarnya telah menimbulkan dampak kesehatan dan sosial serta menuntut solusi inovatif yang berkelanjutan sekaligus berdampak besar. Kontribusi utama kami dalam perjuangan ini tetaplah inovasi terdepan dalam industri dimana kami beroperasi, diantaranya dengan peluncuran Imboost Cough dan Imboost Force Cough, yang memberikan manfaat bagi masyarakat di Indonesia. Namun, kami juga semakin fokus pada pencegahan saat kami berusaha memahami dan mengatasi akar penyebab penyakit yang kami obati.

## Kajian Kinerja 2023

Tahun 2022/23 adalah tahun-tahun pasca-Covid setelah pandemi yang melanda dunia pada tahun 2020-21. Bagi SOHO Global Health, ini adalah tahun-tahun yang penuh tantangan, dan meskipun penjualan produk-produk unggulan kami, terutama Imboost, sangat terpengaruh, namun ekuitas Imboost terus meningkatkan pangsa pasar.

Ditengah kondisi bisnis yang menantang ini, kami terus membuat kemajuan untuk lebih memposisikan bisnis inti kami untuk masa depan. Penjualan bersih kami pada tahun 2023 tumbuh sebesar 12,5% dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya. Namun, penting untuk diakui bahwa pertumbuhan ini terutama disebabkan oleh penjualan yang meningkat dari prinsipal-prinsipal pihak ketiga. Parit Pading Global (PPG), bisnis distribusi kami, mengalami peningkatan pendapatan bersih sebesar 18,9% secara total dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya. Penjualan produk-produk unggulan kami, termasuk divisi Produk Profesional dan Kesehatan Konsumen, secara kolektif mengalami penurunan sebesar -13,8%. Ini sebagian besar disebabkan oleh perlambatan penjualan Imboost yang signifikan pasca-COVID dan masalah dengan regulasi sirup nasional yang berlanjut hingga paruh pertama 2023.

Melihat kembali tahun yang lalu, kami memiliki banyak hal untuk dibanggakan. Menurut data terbaru IQVIA untuk MAT Q4 2023, SOHO Global Health tetap menjadi salah satu dari 20 perusahaan kesehatan teratas di Indonesia, 5 perusahaan OTC teratas, dan 5 perusahaan vitamin teratas. Imboost juga tetap menjadi salah satu dari 5 merek/produk farmasi terbesar di Indonesia. Ini adalah tonggak yang kuat, dan kita harus terus bekerja keras untuk meraih kesuksesan bagi SOHO Global Health. Selain itu, kami memiliki perencanaan inovasi produk yang kuat untuk tahun 2024 dan seterusnya, serta neraca keuangan dengan posisi kas yang kuat untuk melengkapi pertumbuhan organik dengan peluang pertumbuhan anorganik yang mungkin muncul.

# Integrity and good governance

With our plan, our ambition is to renew momentum and, together with our 2,500 employees at SOHO Global Health, create sustainable and competitive growth, as well as value creation. We strive for a model where purpose and performance go hand in hand.

The Board of Directors is also vigilant in its governance oversight efforts, emphasizing values such as integrity as SOHO Global Health maintains its undisputed strong compliance to ethics. In addition, the Executive Leadership Team and the Board of Directors keep an intensive dialogue with stakeholder groups, working towards achieving our vision to be a healthcare leader and the preeminent provider of innovative natural pharmaceutical products.

# 2024 Outlook

The Indonesian economy has successfully recovered from 2021, when the country emerged from the recession zone. In 2022-23, the Indonesian government focused on investment and import substitution to accelerate national economic recovery. These accomplishments in 2022/23 are key milestones towards achieving the Indonesia Vision 2045.

In trade, the government is actively promoting domestic products to accelerate national economic recovery as the nation enters the post-pandemic era in 2022-24. The government has projected economic growth to accelerate in 2024-26 in the 4.7-5.5% range, indicating that Indonesia's economy is continuing to recover after recording a growth of 3.69% in 2021 due to the impact of the Covid-19 pandemic and 5.31% in 2022 and 5.05% in 2023 post-pandemic.

Given these developments, we expect SOHO Global Health to grow its top line by double digit during 2024 and beyond and focus on margins, cash conversion, and accretive capital allocation initiatives to continue to deliver best-in-class total shareholder returns. Innovative solutions and flawless execution will enable the company to tackle challenges and seize opportunities that may arise in the future.

# Integritas dan tata kelola yang baik

Dengan rencana kami, ambisi kami adalah untuk memperbaharui momentum dan, bersama dengan 2.500 karyawan kami di SOHO Global Health, menciptakan pertumbuhan yang berkelanjutan dan kompetitif, serta penciptaan nilai. Kami berusaha untuk menciptakan model bisnis dimana tujuan (purpose) dan kinerja berjalan beriringan.

Dewan Direksi juga sangat memperhatikan upaya pengawasan tata kelola, dengan menekankan nilai-nilai seperti integritas karena SOHO Global Health mempertahankan kepatuhan yang kuat terhadap etika. Selain itu, Tim Kepemimpinan Eksekutif dan Dewan Direksi menjaga komunikasi intensif dengan kelompok pemangku kepentingan, dalam upaya untuk mencapai visi kami menjadi pemimpin di bidang layanan kesehatan dan penyedia terkemuka untuk produk-produk farmasi berbahan alami yang inovatif.

# Proyeksi 2024

Ekonomi Indonesia telah berhasil pulih dari tahun 2021, ketika negara ini keluar dari zona resesi. Pada tahun 2022-23, pemerintah Indonesia fokus pada investasi dan substitusi impor untuk mempercepat pemulihan ekonomi nasional. Prestasi ini pada tahun 2022/23 adalah tonggak kunci menuju pencapaian Visi Indonesia 2045.

Dalam perdagangan, pemerintah secara aktif mempromosikan produk dalam negeri untuk mempercepat pemulihan ekonomi nasional seiring dengan upaya negara ini memasuki era pasca-pandemi tahun 2022-24. Pemerintah telah memproyeksikan pertumbuhan ekonomi akan terakselerasi pada tahun 2024-26 dalam kisaran 4,7-5,5%, menunjukkan bahwa ekonomi Indonesia terus pulih setelah mencatat pertumbuhan sebesar 3,69% pada tahun 2021 akibat dampak pandemi Covid-19 dan 5,31% pada tahun 2022 dan 5,05% pada tahun 2023 pasca-pandemi.

Dengan perkembangan ini, kami mengharapkan SOHO Global Health dapat meningkatkan penjualan dengan pertumbuhan dua digit selama tahun 2024 dan seterusnya, serta fokus pada margin, konversi kas, dan inisiatif alokasi modal yang dapat meningkatkan nilai untuk terus memberikan total pengembalian terbaik bagi para pemegang saham. Solusi inovatif dan eksekusi yang sempurna akan memungkinkan perusahaan untuk mengatasi tantangan dan memanfaatkan peluang yang mungkin muncul di masa depan.

# Equity Securities Under Special Monitoring
Efek Bersifat Ekuitas dalam Pemantauan Khusus

Based on the Announcement from the Indonesian Stock Exchange on May 30, 2023 Number Peng-PK-00017/BEI.I.PP/05-2023 regarding Equity Securities Under Special Monitoring ("IDX Announcement"), the Indonesian Stock Exchange stated that SOHO is categorized as the "Securities Criteria Under Special Monitoring" effective as of May 31, 2023 because SOHO has met the following criteria, namely "having low liquidity with the criteria of an average daily share transaction value of less than IDR 5,000,000.- (five million Rupiah) and the average daily share transaction volume is less than 10,000 (ten thousand) shares during the last 6 (six) months on the Regular Market".

Following up on the IDX Announcement, and after the Company held a joint hearing with the Indonesian Stock Exchange, the Company decided to take corporate action in the form of a stock split ("Stock Split") as the Company's effort to increase liquidity and required transaction volume, and in the context of fulfilling requirements and compliance on the provisions of statutory regulations.

The process and stages carried out by the Company in implementing the Stock Split corporate action have followed all applicable regulatory procedures and provisions as explained by the Company in the "Chronology of Shares Listing" section of this Company's Annual Report.

Berdasarkan Pengumuman dari Bursa Efek Indonesia pada tanggal 30 Mei 2023 Nomor Peng-PK-00017/BEI.I.PP/05-2023 mengenai Efek Bersifat Ekuitas Dalam Pemantauan Khusus ("Pengumuman Bursa"), Bursa Efek Indonesia menyampaikan bahwa SOHO masuk dalam kategori "Kriteria Efek Dalam Pemantauan Khusus" efektif per tanggal 31 Mei 2023 dikarenakan SOHO memenuhi kriteria sebagai berikut, yakni "memiliki likuiditas rendah dengan kriteria nilai transaksi rata-rata harian saham kurang dari Rp5.000.000,- (lima juta rupiah) dan volume transaksi rata-rata harian saham kurang dari 10.000 (sepuluh ribu) saham selama 6 (enam) bulan terakhir di Pasar Reguler".

Menindaklanjuti Pengumuman Bursa tersebut dan setelah Perseroan melakukan audiensi bersama dengan Bursa Efek Indonesia, Perseroan memutuskan untuk melakukan aksi korporasi berupa pemecahan nilai nominal saham ("Stock Split") sebagai upaya Perseroan untuk meningkatkan likuiditas dan volume transaksi sebagaimana dipersyaratkan dan dalam rangka pemenuhan persyaratan dan kepatuhan atas ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.

Proses dan tahapan yang Perseroan lakukan dalam pelaksanaan aksi korporasi Stock Split tersebut telah mengikuti seluruh prosedur dan ketentuan peraturan yang berlaku sebagaimana telah Perseroan jelaskan di dalam Bagian "Kronologi Pencatatan Saham" di dalam Laporan Tahunan Perseroan ini.

# Fulfillment of Requirements for the Number of Free Float Shares
Pemenuhan Ketentuan Persyaratan Jumlah Saham Free Float

On November 24, 2023, the Company received information from one of its shareholders, namely Prysselius Limited, that Prysselius Limited had carried out a sale transaction of some of its shares on November 17, 2023, namely 507,667,300 shares or around 4% of the Company's total shares. ("Prysselius Report"). Referring to the Prysselius Report and the List of Company Shareholders issued by the Company's Securities Administration Bureau, the total percentage of the Company's Free Float Shares has increased from the previous 0.094% to 9.012% of all Company shares. Thus, the Company has fulfilled the provisions for the number of Free Float Shares as required in provision V.1.1 of Indonesian Stock Exchange Regulation No. I-A.

Pada tanggal 24 November 2023, Perseroan telah menerima informasi dari salah satu pemegang sahamnya, yakni Prysselius Limited bahwa Prysselius Limited telah melakukan transaksi penjualan atas sebagian sahamnya pada tanggal 17 November 2023, yakni sejumlah 507.667.300 lembar saham atau sekitar 4% dari seluruh saham Perseroan ("Laporan Prysselius"). Mengacu pada Laporan Prysselius tersebut dan Daftar Pemegang Saham Perseroan yang diterbitkan oleh Biro Administrasi Efek Perseroan, maka total persentase Saham Free Float Perseroan telah meningkat dari yang sebelumnya adalah 0,094% menjadi 9,012% dari seluruh saham Perseroan. Dengan demikian, maka Perseroan telah memenuhi ketentuan jumlah Saham Free Float sebagaimana dipersyaratkan pada ketentuan V.1.1 Peraturan Bursa Efek Indonesia No. I-A.

## Our Business

Bisnis Kami

SOHO Global Health is a leading healthcare company with a more than 70-year history and core competencies in the areas of natural/herbal health care products and services. Our more than 30 group brands range from best seller body defense brands like Imboost to leading kids multivitamin brands like Curcuma Plus and Fitkom. Guided by our corporate purpose "We hold the care of human life as our highest priority and thereby glorify God," we help to prevent and treat diseases, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the well-being of the community. Today we are creating a leading national enterprise built on strong brands and innovative

SOHO has built a solid portfolio of market leading products. Topping the league table is Imboost, one of the fastest growing brands in the Indonesia healthcare market. Curcuma Plus and Diapet make the top three household brands, delivering nutrition and wellness to the community. With a clear focus on actively managing the portfolio and a deep pipeline of new products to sustain growth, SOHO is well-positioned to thrive.

We aim to bolster profitability and create value for our customers, shareholders and employees. Among healthcare professionals, patients and customers, the SOHO Global Health brands stand for trust, reliability and quality. Across our various businesses, our activities are guided by our corporate values of Absolute Integrity, Mutual Respect, Passion for Innovation and Culture of Discipline.

SOHO Global Health offers a unique and best-in-class platform in branding, sales & marketing, manufacturing and distribution to support future growth in the Indonesian market. Supported by over 2400 employees, SGH maintains coverage of ~90% of the targeted doctors, while distribution reaches 95% of hospitals and over 41,000 outlets nationwide.

SOHO Global Health adalah perusahaan terkemuka di bidang kesehatan yang memiliki sejarah lebih dari 70 tahun dan kompetensi inti di bidang layanan kesehatan dan produk natural/herbal. # Seed to Patient

As natural products are at the core of our product offering, we follow a "seed to patient" approach with respect to curcuma, a key ingredient in our Curcuma Group products. Natural medicines can vary considerably depending on how they are produced. Seed to Patient is a method where all of the processes involved in growing and manufacturing natural medicine are tightly controlled to reduce variability. This model is a holistic approach to research focused on each stage of the entire end-to-end product cycle. The process starts with a scientific approach for selecting standardized seeds from superior varieties of curcuma, which helps ensure a controlled and consistent process and product. We then work to innovate at each stage of the natural pharmaceutical value chain.

As part of our innovation process in herbal research, we are working to expand this approach to other ingredients, such as Echinacea, the key ingredient in our best-selling product, Imboost.

Dikarenakan produk herbal merupakan inti dari produk-produk yang ditawarkan, Grup SGH menerapkan konsep "Seed to Patient" untuk temulawak, yang merupakan bahan inti dari produk Grup Curcuma. Kualitas obat-obatan herbal dapat bervariasi tergantung pada bagaimana cara memproduksi. Seed to Patient adalah metode di mana semua proses yang terlibat dalam pembudidayaan dan proses produksi obat herbal dikontrol ketat untuk mengurangi variabilitas ini. Konsep ini merupakan pendekatan holistik untuk penelitian yang berfokus pada setiap tahapan siklus produk dari hulu ke hilir. Proses "Seed to Patient" dimulai dengan pendekatan ilmiah dalam memilih benih standar dari varietas unggul temulawak, yang membantu untuk memastikan proses dan produk yang terkendali dan konsisten. Grup SGH selanjutnya berupaya untuk melakukan inovasi pada setiap tahapan rantai nilai alami.

Sebagai bukti keseriusan kami dalam menghadirkan inovasi produk berbahan herbal, Grup SGH saat ini sedang berusaha untuk menerapkan proses ini ke bahan-bahan dasar lainnya seperti Echinacea yang merupakan bahan dasar utama produk best-seller kami, Imboost.

# Human Capital

## Sumber Daya Manusia

SGH Group consistently prioritizes the human resources development as the company's main asset. The Company believes that achieving strategic goals and a successful operational is an integral part of employee dedication which requires skills and creativity of our extraordinary human resources.

Human resources management at SGH Group begins with the recruitment process. From this very first stage, the Company is fully committed to human rights, particularly in protecting children's rights by establishing general requirements for candidates, which include a minimum age of 18 (eighteen) years. This provision has also been regulated in detail in the Collective Labor Agreement and Company Regulations as well as SOP of Recruitment Management.

SGH Group is strongly committed to structured and definite policies, ensuring that every employee, regardless of gender, race, religion, ethnicity, or particular social groups, has equal opportunities in terms of development, remuneration, career development and employee remuneration.

SGH Group secara konsisten memprioritaskan pengembangan sumber daya manusia sebagai aset utama perusahaan. Perusahaan percaya bahwa keberhasilan operasional dan pencapaian tujuan strategis tidak terlepas dari dedikasi, keterampilan, dan kreativitas sumber daya manusia kami yang luar biasa.

Pengelolaan sumber daya manusia di SGH Group diawali dengan tahap rekrutmen. Dalam tahap ini, perusahaan sepenuhnya berkomitmen untuk melindungi Hak Asasi Manusia khususnya Hak Asasi Anak dengan menetapkan persyaratan umum bagi calon karyawan, yang mencakup usia minimal 18 (delapan belas) tahun. Ketentuan ini juga telah diatur secara rinci dalam Perjanjian Kerja Bersama dan Peraturan Perusahaan serta SOP Manajemen Rekrutmen.

SGH Group berkomitmen kuat dengan kebijakan yang jelas dan terstruktur, menjamin bahwa setiap karyawan, tanpa memandang jenis kelamin, ras, agama, etnis, atau kelompok sosial tertentu, memiliki kesempatan yang setara dalam hal pengembangan, remunerasi, pertumbuhan karir, dan remunerasi Karyawan.

Fulfilment of Human Resources (HR) with qualified competencies is very much needed to increase productivity and develop a strong team in the Company. Since the recruitment and selection process, SGH does not tolerate any form of discrimination based on race, skin colour, gender, age, language, religion, ethnicity, and social background.

The complex SGH organization with various Business Units ranging from R&D, Manufacturing, Marketing and Sales, Distribution, along with all supporting units such as Business Development, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Internal Audit, Compliance, Information Technology, and others requires a very diverse range of candidates, with various educational backgrounds and work experience.

In meeting HR needs, the Company actively recruits new graduates and professionals with the aim of leading to the company's success. Apart from that, the Company also selectively re-employs retirees as experts in certain fields. This strategy is also one of the actions taken by the Company in implementing the principles of inclusion in the Company.

Before starting the selection process for prospective employees, the recruitment team first prepares a plan for workforce needs within a certain period, maps it every year. The recruitment process involves identifying and selecting appropriate candidates for job positions based on qualifications, skills, and suitability to the Company's culture and goals.

# Periodic Medical Check-up for SGH Group Employees Year 2023

Pemeriksaan Kesehatan Berkala Karyawan SGH Group Tahun 2023

To maintain the health status and ensure that all employees are in good health, the Company once again held a periodic medical check-up for year 2023, which among others aims to:

a. Early detection of the Occupational Diseases;
b. Ensure the physical abilities and health of employees in doing their job as to prevent occupational accidents; and
c. As a form of Company compliance with the Regulation of the Minister of Manpower and Transmigration No. Per.02/MEN/1980 concerning Medical Examination of Workers.

Prior to conducting the medical check-up in 2023, the Company has selected clinical laboratories that met our requirements as providers of health examination services, including specific requirements in the post-COVID-19 pandemic. In addition to document requirements, the feasibility of clinical laboratory facilities is also assessed by conducting a direct visit to the clinic.

The periodic medical check-up for SGH Group employees has been held from July to September 2023, at the head office along with all branch offices. More than 2300 employees attended this periodic medical check-up.

The results of this medical check-up will be used as a Company evaluation in mapping the employees' health status in 2023, compared to previous years, as well as a basis for analyzing previously determined medical check-up objectives, and planning the Company's program for employees, especially those related to employee's health.

![img-101.jpeg](img-101.jpeg)

Dalam upaya mempertahankan derajat kesehatan dan memastikan seluruh karyawan dalam keadaan sehat selama bekerja, Perusahaan kembali melakukan pemeriksaan kesehatan berkala di tahun 2023, yang antara lain bertujuan untuk:

a. Deteksi dini terhadap kemungkinan timbulnya Penyakit Akibat Kerja (PAK);
b. Memastikan kemampuan fisik dan kesehatan karyawan dalam menjalani pekerjaannya sehingga dapat mencegah terjadinya kecelakaan kerja; dan
c. Sebagai bentuk kepatuhan Perusahaan terhadap Peraturan Menteri Tenaga Kerja dan Transmigrasi No. Per.02/MEN/1980 tentang Pemeriksaan Kesehatan Tenaga Kerja dalam Penyelenggaraan Keselamatan Kerja.

Sebelum melaksanakan pemeriksaan kesehatan berkala tahun 2023, Perusahaan terlebih dahulu menyelaksi dan memilih laboratorium klinik yang memenuhi persyaratan sebagai penyedia jasa pemeriksaan kesehatan, termasuk persyaratan khusus dalam situasi pasca pandemi COVID-19. Selain persyaratan dokumen, kelayakan fasilitas laboratorium klinik juga ditinjau dengan mengadakan kunjungan langsung ke laboratorium klinik yang dimaksud.

Pemeriksaan kesehatan berkala karyawan SGH Group tahun 2023 diselenggarakan mulai bulan Juli sampai dengan September 2023 di kantor pusat dan seluruh kantor cabang. Pemeriksaan kesehatan berkala ini diikuti lebih dari 2300 karyawan.

Hasil pemeriksaan kesehatan berkala ini digunakan sebagai bahan evaluasi Perusahaan dalam memetakan status kesehatan seluruh karyawan pada tahun 2023, melihat perbandingan dengan tahun-tahun sebelumnya, serta sebagai basis dalam menganalisa tujuan pemeriksaan kesehatan yang telah ditetapkan sebelumnya, serta untuk merencanakan program Perusahaan bagi karyawan terutama yang berkaitan dengan kesehatan.

# Employee Training and Development

## Pelatihan dan Pengembangan Karyawan

Employee training and development is the best investment that strengthens our human capital and benefits both Employees and the Company. SGH believes that employee development must be consistently managed from time to time, both technical and non-technical competencies which are expected to have an impact on optimal work results. Planning for employee training and development needs in SGH Group is tailored based on the needs of each Business Unit every year by considering dynamic market conditions as well as the skills of the workforce to run the business. Development programs with digital approach i.e. e-learning and webinars become an adaptive learning method that can reach all employees, both at the head office and branch offices throughout Indonesia.

During 2023, SGH total training duration reached 24,955 hours. The average training hours per employee by the end of 2023 was 21,97 hours per employee per year.

Pelatihan dan pengembangan karyawan merupakan investasi terbaik yang memperkuat sumber daya manusia dan memberi manfaat baik bagi Karyawan maupun Perusahaan. SGH percaya bahwa pengembangan karyawan harus dikelola secara konsisten dari waktu ke waktu, baik kemampuan teknis maupun non-teknis yang diharapkan dapat berdampak pada hasil kerja yang optimal. Perencanaan kebutuhan pengembangan dan pelatihan karyawan SGH Group disesuaikan berdasarkan kebutuhan masing-masing Unit Bisnis pada setiap tahunnya, dengan mempertimbangkan dinamika dan kondisi pasar serta kemampuan Sumber Daya Manusia (SDM) yang mumpuni untuk menjalankan bisnis. Pelatihan dengan pendekatan digital berupa sistem pembelajaran elektronik dan webinar menjadi alternatif metode pembelajaran yang adaptif, mampu menjangkau seluruh karyawan baik yang berlokasi di kantor pusat maupun kantor-kantor cabang yang tersebar di seluruh Indonesia.

Selama tahun 2023, secara keseluruhan durasi pelatihan SGH Group mencapai 24.955 jam. Durasi pelatihan rata-rata per karyawan di akhir 2023 adalah 21.97 jam per karyawan per tahun.

Employee competency development in SGH Group is carried out in the form of e-learning, internal training, and external training. E-learning is a learning method using a digital platform that allows employees to learn online anytime and anywhere. Internal training covers technical topics and soft skills which are managed by Technical Related in the relevant Business Unit and are designed to support business growth. External training, among others, directed at enhancing leadership skills, advancing soft skills to fill competency gaps in certain positions, as well as employee certification related to government regulations.

Pengembangan kompetensi karyawan di SGH Group antara lain dilaksanakan dalam bentuk e-learning, pelatihan internal, dan pelatihan eksternal. In addition to SOHO Academy which is managed by the S&O Business Unit, other employee development managed by the Distribution Business Unit is "PPG Buddy Program", an experiential learning program with mentoring methods by a mentor/buddy. The PPG Buddy Program in 2023 is a pilot project for the positions of Branch Logistics Supervisor and Branch Accounting Supervisor in several PPG Branch Offices, which among other things aims to: (a) improving performance at the PPG Distribution Branch to ensure the achievement of the national targets that have been set; (b) equalizing process standards in the area of Logistics and Accounting; (c) improving buddy competence; and (d) scored PPG's Future Leader. This PPG Buddy Program has been implemented for nine months from January to September 2023.

The duties and responsibilities of a mentor/buddy include accompanying, sharing experiences, and guiding the mentee in improving achievements at the branch office for which he is responsible. Assistance conducted periodically and intensively, including monitoring daily operational activities.

Selain SOHO Academy yang dikelola oleh Unit Bisnis S&O, bentuk pengembangan karyawan lainnya dikelola oleh Unit Bisnis Distribusi berupa "PPG Buddy Program", yakni suatu program pembelajaran berdasarkan pengalaman dengan metode pendampingan oleh seorang mentor/buddy. PPG Buddy Program di tahun 2023 ini merupakan proyek percontohan pada jabatan Pengawas Logistik Cabang dan Pengawas Keuangan Cabang di beberapa Kantor Cabang PPG, yang antara lain bertujuan untuk: (a) peningkatan prestasi di Kantor Distribusi PPG guna memastikan tercapainya target nasional yang telah ditetapkan; (b) pemerataan standar proses di bagian logistik dan bagian keuangan; (c) meningkatkan kompetensi karyawan yang menjadi mentor/buddy; dan (d) mencetak pemimpin masa depan PPG. PPG Buddy Program ini dilaksanakan selama sembilan bulan, yakni mulai bulan Januari sampai dengan September 2023.

Tugas dan tanggung jawab seorang mentor/buddy termasuk mendampingi, berbagi pengalaman, serta membimbing mentee dalam meningkatkan prestasi di kantor cabang yang menjadi tanggung jawabnya. Pendampingan dilakukan secara berkala dan intensif termasuk dalam memantau kegiatan operasional sehari-hari.

Prior to carrying out his role as a mentor/buddy, various technical briefings have been carried out by the PPG Operational Excellence team and other related sections such as Branch Logistics Development as well as from the HR Department which provides training including coaching techniques, mentoring, and skills for carrying out supervision, so that the mentor/buddy is ready to interact with the mentee and the branch office he will accompany.

To maximize the process and expected results, the mentor/buddy also conducts onsite visits to the mentee's branch office, so that he can see it directly and be able to better understand the process, any obstacles, and find the root of the problems that occur at the branch office, as well as get input from the Branch Manager and Supervisors in interconnected Branch Offices, to recommend process improvements, development and problem solving in the branch office.

Sebelum menjalankan peran sebagai seorang mentor/buddy, berbagai pembekalan teknis telah dilakukan oleh tim PPG Operational Excellence dan bagian terkait lainnya seperti Pengembangan Logistik Cabang serta dari Departemen SDM yang memberikan pembekalan berupa teknik coaching, mentoring, dan keterampilan untuk melakukan pengawasan, sehingga para mentor/buddy siap untuk berinteraksi dengan mentee dan kantor cabang yang akan didampinginya.

Untuk memaksimalkan proses dan hasil yang diharapkan, mentor/buddy juga melakukan kunjungan langsung ke kantor cabang mentee, sehingga dapat melihat secara langsung dan mampu lebih memahami proses, adanya kendala, serta menemukan akar masalah yang terjadi di kantor cabang, juga mendapatkan masukan dari Kepala Cabang maupun Supervisor di kantor cabang yang saling berhubungan, untuk merekomendasikan perbaikan proses, pengembangan, dan penyelesaian masalah di kantor cabang tersebut.

## Indonesia Economic Outlook 2024-26
Pandangan Ekonomi Indonesia 2024-26

With resilient macroeconomic underpinnings and the end of the post-COVID recovery cycle, the policy focus turns again to the growth agenda. The World Bank projects robust growth for Indonesia in 2023-24, dipping slightly to 4.9% in 2024-26, reflecting softer terms of trade and a normalization toward trend growth. At home, Bank Indonesia (BI) projects economic growth to accelerate in 2024-26 in the 4.7-5.5% range.

Private consumption supported by domestic demand will be the primary driver of growth, primarily in the form of ongoing consumption growth, including the positive impact of the general election and increasing investment, particularly building investment, in line with current national strategic projects (PSN) development, encompassing the new capital city (IKN). Meanwhile, export performance remains subdued as a corollary of global economic moderation and lower international commodity prices. [Hint: Global economic growth is projected at 3.0% in 2023 before slowing to 2.8% in 2024]. By sector, the outlook for the manufacturing industry, wholesale and retail trade, information and communication, construction, as well as transportation and storage is promising. Spatially, solid growth is also projected in all regions of the archipelago, particularly in Sulawesi-Maluku-Papua due to mineral downstreaming, as well as in the Java region in response to consistently strong domestic demand.

Secara singkat, semua indikator bergerak menuju arah yang lebih positif. PDB tumbuh sebesar 5,04% pada Kuartal IV 2023, didukung oleh permintaan domestik yang kuat. Neraca Pembayaran Indonesia (BOP) diproyeksikan mencatat surplus pada tahun 2023, yang akan memperkuat ketahanan eksternal. Stabilitas nilai tukar Rupiah telah dipertahankan sejalan dengan konsistensi kebijakan moneter oleh Bank Indonesia.

Dengan landasan makroekonomi yang tangguh dan berakhirnya siklus pemulihan pasca-COVID, fokus kebijakan kembali ke agenda pertumbuhan. Bank Dunia memproyeksikan pertumbuhan yang kuat bagi Indonesia pada tahun 2023-24, sedikit menurun menjadi 4,9% pada tahun 2024-26, mencerminkan perdagangan yang sedikit melemah dan normalisasi menuju tren pertumbuhan. Di dalam negeri, Bank Indonesia (BI) memproyeksikan pertumbuhan ekonomi akan mengalami percepatan pada tahun 2024-26 dalam kisaran 4,7-5,5%.

Konsumsi swasta yang didukung oleh permintaan domestik akan menjadi penggerak utama pertumbuhan, terutama dalam bentuk pertumbuhan konsumsi yang berkelanjutan, termasuk dampak positif dari pemilihan umum dan peningkatan investasi, khususnya investasi pembangunan, sejalan dengan pengembangan Proyek Strategis Nasional (PSN) saat ini, yang meliputi pembangunan ibu kota baru (IKN). Sementara itu, kinerja ekspor tetap tertahan sebagai akibat dari moderasi ekonomi global dan penurunan harga komoditas internasional. [Hint: Pertumbuhan ekonomi global diproyeksikan mencapai 3,0% pada tahun 2023 sebelum melambat menjadi 2,8% pada tahun 2024]. Secara sektoral, proyeksi untuk industri manufaktur, perdagangan grosir dan eceran, informasi dan komunikasi, konstruksi, serta transportasi dan penyimpanan menjanjikan. Secara spasial, pertumbuhan solid juga diproyeksikan di semua wilayah kepulauan, terutama di Sulawesi-Maluku-Papua karena hilir-minyak bumi, serta di wilayah Jawa sebagai respons terhadap permintaan domestik yang terus kuat.

Indonesia total healthcare market looks stagnant in terms of MAT 4Q23, held back by Vaccine with few products. If J07-Vaccine is excluded, MAT 4Q23 still showing positive outlook, +1.5% MAT growth. # 2024 Strategy

## Strategi 2024

## Driving Sustainable Growth

Mendorong Pertumbuhan Berkelanjutan

At SOHO Global Health, we believe in the potential of science, the transformational power of technology and the endless possibilities to change the lives of patients and consumers. Our everyday decisions are guided by our company values. We want to demonstrate courage, achievement, responsibility, respect, integrity and transparency in every step we take, in every decision we make.

Di SOHO Global Health, kami percaya pada potensi ilmu pengetahuan, kekuatan transformatif teknologi, dan kemungkinan tak terbatas untuk mengubah kehidupan pasien dan konsumen. Keputusan kami sehari-hari dipandu oleh nilai-nilai perusahaan kami. Kami ingin menunjukkan keberanian, pencapaian, tanggung jawab, rasa hormat, integritas, dan transparansi dalam setiap langkah yang kami ambil, dalam setiap keputusan yang kami buat.

![img-124.jpeg](img-124.jpeg)

During 2018-23 significant progress was made in positioning the Group for accelerated profits in higher margin, growing businesses. Together we have built the foundation for sustained success and defined the road ahead for SOHO Global Health. This strategy is based on our core competences, external trends that will impact our industry and a concrete map on how to reach our future ambition.

In 2024, a post-Covid era, the key strategy for Professional Products business is to expand doctors and hospital coverage, predominantly via direct coverage while continue leveraging digital engagement with HCPs. What matter the most for Consumer Health business is to ensure the success of new launches, increase Imboost brand awareness and trial, expand Diapet distribution drive to accelerate its growth, and to revitalize our kids multivitamin brands.

Selama periode 2018-23, kemajuan signifikan telah dicapai dalam memposisikan Grup untuk mempercepat keuntungan dalam bisnis yang tumbuh dengan margin lebih tinggi. Bersama-sama, kami telah membangun dasar untuk kesuksesan yang berkelanjutan dan menetapkan jalan ke depan untuk SOHO Global Health. Strategi ini didasarkan pada kompetensi inti kami, tren eksternal yang akan berdampak pada industri kami, dan peta konkrit tentang bagaimana mencapai ambisi masa depan kami.

Pada tahun 2024, di era pasca-Covid, strategi utama bisnis Produk Professional adalah memperluas cakupan dokter dan rumah sakit, terutama melalui peningkatan cakupan langsung sambil terus memanfaatkan keterlibatan digital dengan professional kesehatan. Sementara itu, yang paling penting bagi bisnis Kesehatan Konsumen adalah memastikan kesuksesan peluncuran produk baru, meningkatkan kesadaran merek Imboost dan uji coba (trial), memperluas distribusi Diapet untuk mempercepat pertumbuhannya, dan merevitalisasi merek multivitamin anak yang kami miliki.

Key strategy in 2024 for Distribution and Logistic business, the biggest business in the Group in terms of sales, is to grow top line, lever fixed costs and expand margins. While Alliance and our strategic ventures will need to continue focus on core business and ensure the success of new launches to achieve aggressive growth and improve profitability.

Overall, in 2024 we are going to continue to invest behind our key brands by introducing new important variants to meet the needs of existing and new consumers and patients, by increasing awareness and trial and by expanding distribution with a special focus on independent pharmacies, modern trade and the general trade channel. Moreover, we will further strengthen scientific communication with HCPs, that are crucial to the success of important product innovations like Gastin Force, our evidence based herbal formula that is highly effective to treat a broad range of gastrointestinal conditions.

We believe that long-term value creation is the result of both growth and operating efficiency. We achieve sustainable top-line growth by investing selectively in high-growth categories. To generate efficiency improvements, since 2014, we have made significant efforts to restructure and reshape our business controlling costs and improving long-term competitiveness.

It is our goal to continue to accelerate growth, expand our market footprint and sustain our leadership positions within our specialty areas. We have clearly defined goals, such as sustaining above-market growth in our core businesses. Professional Products and Consumer Health shall contribute significantly to our growth ambition with the main drivers being new product launches and strong base business delivery. We are aiming at achieving sustained organic profitable growth, while targeted acquisitions remain an option.

Strategi utama pada tahun 2024 bisnis Distribusi dan Logistik, bisnis terbesar dalam Grup dari segi penjualan, adalah untuk meningkatkan pendapatan, memanfaatkan leverage biaya tetap, dan memperluas margin. Sementara itu, Alliance dan usaha strategis lain yang kami miliki perlu terus fokus pada bisnis inti dan memastikan kesuksesan peluncuran produk baru untuk mencapai pertumbuhan agresif dan meningkatkan profitabilitas.

Secara keseluruhan, pada tahun 2024 kami akan terus berinvestasi mendukung merek-merek utama kami dengan memperkenalkan varian-varian baru yang penting untuk memenuhi kebutuhan konsumen dan pasien yang sudah ada maupun pasien baru, dengan meningkatkan kesadaran dan uji coba (trial) serta dengan memperluas distribusi dengan fokus khusus pada apotek independen, modern trade, dan general trade. Selain itu, kami akan lebih memperkuat komunikasi ilmiah dengan professional kesehatan yang sangat penting untuk kesuksesan produk inovatif kami seperti Gastin Force, formula herbal berbasis bukti yang sangat efektif untuk mengobati berbagai kondisi gastrointestinal.

Kami percaya bahwa penciptaan nilai jangka panjang adalah hasil dari pertumbuhan bisnis dan efisiensi operasional. Kami mencapai pertumbuhan bisnis yang berkelanjutan dengan berinvestasi secara selektif pada kategori-kategori bisnis dengan pertumbuhan tinggi. Untuk menghasilkan peningkatan efisiensi, sejak tahun 2014, kami telah melakukan upaya yang signifikan untuk restrukturisasi dan reshape bisnis kami dengan mengendalikan biaya dan meningkatkan daya saing jangka panjang.

Tujuan kami adalah untuk terus mempercepat pertumbuhan, memperluas jejak pasar kami, dan mempertahankan posisi kepemimpinan kami dalam bidang spesialisasi kami. Kami memiliki tujuan yang jelas, seperti mempertahankan pertumbuhan di atas pasar dalam bisnis inti kami. Produk Profesional dan Kesehatan Konsumen akan memberikan kontribusi yang signifikan terhadap ambisi pertumbuhan kami dengan penggerak utama adalah peluncuran produk baru dan pertumbuhan bisnis inti kami yang kuat. Kami bertujuan untuk mencapai pertumbuhan organik yang menguntungkan secara berkelanjutan, sementara akuisisi yang sesuai target tetap menjadi opsi pertumbuhan.

# Business Review

Tinjauan Usaha

## Professional Products Division

Divisi Produk Profesional

## Overview

The products in this segment are marketed to and prescribed by healthcare professionals (HCPs) in hospitals and clinics in Indonesia. Although these products can also be purchased without a prescription, they are generally recommended and/or prescribed by HCPs. We have more than 300 medical representatives nationwide, dedicated to educating HCPs, selling, and marketing these products.

Overall, the pharmaceutical market has almost stagnated with a growth of -0.1% based on IQVIA MAT 4Q23. Prescription products contribute 66.0% to the total market. The prescription drug category shows a growth of 3.6%, mainly driven by generic drugs, while the over-the-counter (OTC) market has declined by -7.1%.

The Net Sales of the Professional Products division throughout 2023 showed a negative growth of -11.4%, lower than in 2022, mainly influenced by the end of the Covid-19 pandemic, which led to a decrease in sales of immune-boosting products. The temporary restriction by BPOM related to the national syrup issue in the fourth quarter of 2022 also continued to impact the decline in sales of syrup products in the Professional Products division in the first half of 2023, including existing products like Imboost Force syrup, Curvit syrup, and new products like Gastin Force syrup.

Despite experiencing a decline in sales, Imboost Force remains the product with the largest sales contribution to the Professional Products business. In 2023, we expanded the Imboost Force product line by introducing Imboost Force Cough syrup, a cough medicine specifically innovated for children, which is expected to broaden the range and strengthen the Imboost Force product portfolio.

## Gambaran Umum

Produk-produk di segmen ini dipasarkan ke, dan diresepkan oleh penyedia layanan kesehatan di rumah sakit dan klinik di Indonesia. Walaupun produk ini juga dapat dibeli tanpa resep, namun umumnya direkomendasikan dan atau diresepkan oleh tenaga kesehatan profesional. Kami memiliki tenaga penjualan lebih dari 300 perwakilan medis di seluruh negeri, yang didedikasikan untuk melakukan edukasi ke tenaga kesehatan profesional, menjual dan memasarkan produk-produk ini.

Secara umum total pasar farmasi hampir tidak bergerak dengan pertumbuhan -0.1% berdasarkan IQVIA MAT 4Q23. Produk resep (Ethical) berkontribusi sebesar 66.0% dari total pasar. Kategori obat resep menunjukkan pertumbuhan yang positif sebesar 3.6% yang terutama dipengaruhi oleh pertumbuhan pasar obat generik, sedangkan pasar di kategori obat bebas (OTC) mengalami penurunan sebesar -7.1%.

Penjualan Bersih divisi Produk Profesional sepanjang tahun 2023 menunjukkan pertumbuhan negatif sebesar -11.4% lebih rendah dibandingkan tahun 2022, yang utamanya dipengaruhi oleh berakhirnya pandemi Covid-19, yang berdampak pada turunnya penjualan untuk produk peningkat daya tahan tubuh. Pelarangan sementara oleh BPOM terkait dengan isu sirup nasional di Q4 2022, juga masih berdampak terhadap penurunan penjualan produk sirup divisi Produk Profesional di semester I 2023, baik produk existing seperti Imboost Force sirup, Curvit sirup, maupun produk baru seperti Gastin Force sirup.

Kendati mengalami penurunan penjualan, Imboost Force tetap menjadi produk dengan kontribusi penjualan terbesar bagi bisnis Produk Profesional. Di tahun 2023 kami menambah lini produk Imboost Force dengan menghadirkan Imboost Force Cough sirup, obat batuk khusus untuk anak, yang diharapkan akan memperluas range dan memperkuat portfolio produk Imboost Force.

# 2023 Highlights

SGH's Professional Products division (OTx category) recorded a negative growth of -11.4% at the end of 2023, amounting to Rp 395.8 billion, contributing 4.8% to SGH's total net sales. The gross profit margin reached 80.8% in 2023, down from 82.3% in 2022.

# Consumer Health Division
Divisi Produk Kesehatan Konsumen

## Overview

The Consumer Health Division (CH) specializes in over-the-counter (OTC) products sold through retail outlets and online. We are the leader in natural and herbal OTC supplement/multivitamin products marketed directly to consumers in Indonesia, with several flagship brands such as Imboost, Curcuma Plus, Fitkom, Diapet, Laxing, and others.

Net sales growth for CH decreased by -15.8% compared to 2022. This decline in sales is primarily due to Imboost being affected by changes in consumer behavior regarding the consumption of vitamins after the end of the Covid-19 pandemic. Other reasons for the decrease include cases of EG-DEG contamination in some syrup medications produced by competitors, resulting in acute kidney failure cases in children. The Ministry of Health has prohibited the sale of syrup medications and supplements from mid-October 2022 until they receive safe verification from BPOM. The syrup issue persisted until the first semester of 2023.

According to IQVIA, Indonesia Total Market MAT 4Q23, the Imboost Franchise (comprising Imboost Regular-CH and Imboost Force-PP) ranked 5th among the top 20 best-selling pharmaceutical products in Indonesia, both in prescription and over-the-counter categories.

Consumer Health (CH) products are marketed directly to consumers through offline and online retailers across Indonesia. Our products are easily accessible through various sales channels, including retail pharmacies, modern trade pharmacies, minimarkets, supermarkets, convenience stores, and e-commerce channels. Most of our Consumer Health products are manufactured by the SGH Group, with some products produced by local suppliers for the SGH Group's brand names.

## 2023 Highlights

Soho Consumer Health recorded a decrease in net sales of -15.8% by the end of 2023, amounting to IDR 430.6 billion and contributing approximately 5.3% to SGH's total net sales. Gross profit margin decreased to 68.8% in 2023 compared to 70.7% the previous year, driven by the declining sales contribution from Imboost due to the end of the Covid-19 pandemic and national syrup issues.

The marketing strategy and priorities for 2023 are focused on two main areas:

1. Driving growth and market share for Imboost as the top priority brand by adapting and optimizing investments due to the sharp decline in demand for vitamin categories in the post-pandemic era. Furthermore, preparing for future growth by expanding the Imboost brand into new categories through the launch of the new Imboost Cough syrup product for children and adults, in parallel with the launch of Imboost Force Cough Kids for doctor's prescriptions.

## Gambaran Umum

Divisi Kesehatan Konsumen (CH) mengkhususkan diri pada produk OTC yang dijual melalui gerai ritel dan online. Kami adalah pemimpin dalam produk suplemen/multivitamin OTC alami dan herbal yang dipasarkan langsung ke konsumen di Indonesia dengan beberapa brand unggulan seperti Imboost, Curcuma Plus, Fitkom, Diapet, Laxing, dll.

Pertumbuhan Penjualan Bersih CH turun sebesar -15.8% dibandingkan tahun 2022. Penurunan sales ini terutama disebabkan oleh Imboost yang terdampak oleh perubahan perilaku konsumen atas konsumsi vitamin setelah berakhirnya pandemi Covid-19. Penyebab penurunan lainnya karena adanya kasus tercemarnya EG-DEG pada beberapa obat sirup produksi kompetitor yang mengakibatkan kasus gagal ginjal akut pada anak. Kemenkes melarang penjualan obat-obatan dan suplemen bentuk sirup dari pertengahan Oktober 2022 sampai mendapatkan verifikasi aman dari BPOM. Isu sirup ini masih berlangsung sampai dengan Semester 1 2023.

Menurut IQVIA, Indonesia Total Market MAT 4Q23, Imboost Franchise (gabungan Imboost Regular-CH dan Imboost Force-PP) menduduki peringkat ke-5 di antara top 20 produk farmasi terlaris di Indonesia baik dalam kategori resep maupun OTC.

Produk CH dipasarkan langsung ke konsumen melalui perantara offline and online retailer di seluruh Indonesia. Produk kami sangat mudah diakses di seluruh saluran penjualan, di apotek ritel, modern trade apotek, Minimarket, supermarket, toko kelontong, hingga e-commerce channel. Sebagian besar produk Kesehatan Konsumen kami diproduksi oleh Grup SGH, dengan beberapa produk diproduksi oleh pemasok lokal untuk nama merek Grup SGH.

## Pencapaian 2023

Soho Consumer Health mencatat penurunan penjualan bersih sebesar -15.8% pada akhir tahun 2023 menjadi Rp 430.6 miliar dan menyumbang 5.3% dari total penjualan bersih SGH. Margin Laba Kotor turun menjadi 68.8% pada tahun 2023 dibandingkan 70.7% tahun lalu, didorong oleh kontribusi penjualan Imboost yang menurun, karena berakhirnya pandemi Covid-19 dan isu sirup nasional.

Strategi dan prioritas pemasaran pada tahun 2023 difokuskan pada dua (2) area utama:

# Overview

We established our distribution business in 1956, giving us a long track record as a successful pharmaceutical and consumer goods distribution partner. As the distribution arm of SOHO Global Health (the "Group"), Parit Padang Global (PPG) distributes both our own products and products for over 50 third-party partners ("PPG Principals"). We are distributors for Indonesian Pharmaceutical & MedTech companies, such as Yarindo, Fahrenheit, Dipa Pharmalab, Global Dispomedika (GDM), Berno, Pharos Indonesia, Mahakam Beta Farma, Kalbe Farma, Hexpharm Jaya, Sari Enesis, Hanasui and multinational companies, such as Bayer, Johnson & Johnson, Mundipharma, Haleon, BBraun, Kenvue, Eisai, IDS Med, Hetero (Amarox), Fresenius Medical Care, L'Oreal and 3M. We represent more than two-thirds (2/3) of our PPG portfolio of products on an exclusive basis, which can vary in scope and range from nationwide exclusivity to market channel or product exclusivity.

Distribution through PPG is a key enabler for our Professional Products and Consumer Health businesses. Our extensive distribution network ensures that any new products we launch are available across Indonesia through all our distribution channels, from hospitals to minimarkets.

Our logistic network provides extensive coverage across the entire Indonesian archipelago, with a reach of approximately 95% of hospitals and pharmacies in Indonesia, as well as many modern and traditional outlets. This is made possible through our 25 branches and three sales offices, as well as over 30 networks of third-party sub-distributors.

Our platform is supported by over 500 outsourced intermediate and last-mile delivery vehicles, as well as a cold storage logistics chain for products that require 2-8 degree Celsius warehousing. Our distribution network has the capacity to handle over 27,900 pallets across all branches, including our central warehouse. We are proud to be one of the few distributors in Indonesia awarded the International Good Storage and Distribution Practice Certificate from the Societe Generale de Surveillance, as well as the ISO 9001:2015 certificate for quality management systems, the Certificate of Method of Good Distribution of Medicines (CDOB) from BPOM RI, and the Certificate of Method of Good Distribution of Healthcare Devices (CDAKB).

2023 Highlights

Pencapaian 2023

The Distribution and Logistics Division registered double-digit net sales growth in 2023, rising from IDR 5,987 billion to IDR 7,120 billion, which represents an  $18.9\%$  increase. This performance was mainly due to the success of principals which rebounded post-Covid-19 as well as new principal additions. In addition, the gross profit margin remained strong at  $8.3\%$  from  $8.7\%$  previous year, due to a well-managed product portfolio mix.

Our remarkable sales growth was the result of our efforts to build a competitive advantage through digitalization and automation, among others. "PPGOS," which stands for PPG Online System, is one of the innovations introduced by PPG to maintain its lead in the digital era. Through this online application, PPG offers its B2B customers (pharmacies, private hospitals, and clinics) convenience in placing orders. Since the nationwide launch in November 2019, the progress has been very positive, with over 25,000 customers registered at the end of December 2023 and a  $40\%$  sales contribution from related channels.

Divisi Distribusi dan Logistik mencatat pertumbuhan penjualan bersih yang mencapai duala digit pada tahun 2023, naik dari Rp 5.987 miliar menjadi Rp 7.120 miliar, kepada mengalami peningkatan sebesar  $18.9\%$ . Kinerja ini terutama disebabkan oleh keberhasilan prinsip-prinsipal yang pulih pasca pandemi Covid-19 serta beberapa tambahan prinsipal baru. Selain itu, margin laba kotor tetap kuat pada  $8.3\%$  dari sebelumnya  $8.7\%$ , berkat portofolio produk yang dikelola dengan baik.

Pertumbuhan penjualan luar biasa kami adalah telah dari upaya kami untuk membangun keunggulan kompetitif melalui digitalisasi dan otomatisasi, di antara hal lainnya. "PPGOS," yang merupakan singkatan dari PPG Online System, adalah telah satu inovasi yang diperkenalkan PPG untuk mempertahankan posisi kepemimpinanya di era digital. Melalui aplikasi online ini, PPG menawarkan kemudahan kepada pelanggan B2B-nya (apotek, rumah sakit swasta, dan klinik) dalam melakukan pemesanan. Sejak diluncurkan secara nasional pada November 2019, perkembangannya sangat positif, dengan lebih dari 25.000 pelanggan terdaftar pada akhir Desember 2023 dan kontribusi penjualan sebesar  $40\%$  dari saluran terkait.

Representing 86.8% of the total, the Distribution segment remains the largest contributor to the Company's net revenues. Net revenues from this segment increased by IDR 1.1 trillion, or 18.9%, compared to the previous year. This performance was mainly due to the increase in the 3rd party principal's sales, which kept growing steadily, as well as the addition of a few new principals. The gross profit margin remained stable at 8.3% from 8.7% previous year, thanks to a well-managed product portfolio mix.

Net Sales of the Professional Products division in 2023 were 11.4% lower than in 2022, due to the end of the Covid-19 pandemic, leading to a general decline in sales of immune-boosting products. Despite the decrease, Imboost Force remains the product with the largest contribution to the Professional Products business.

Mewakili 86,8% dari total, segmen Distribusi tetap menjadi kontributor terbesar bagi pendapatan neto Perseroan. Pendapatan neto dari segmen ini meningkat sebesar Rp1,1 triliun, atau 18,9%, dibandingkan dengan tahun lalu. Kinerja ini terutama disebabkan oleh peningkatan penjualan produk prinsipal, yang pulih pasca-Covid-19, serta penambahan beberapa prinsipal baru. Margin laba kotor tetap kuat di angka 8,3% dari 8,7% tahun sebelumnya, berkat pengelolaan portofolio produk yang baik.

Penjualan Bersih divisi Produk Profesional pada tahun 2023 turun 11,4% dibandingkan dengan tahun 2022, disebabkan oleh berakhirnya pandemi Covid-19, yang mengakibatkan penurunan secara umum penjualan untuk produk penambah daya tahan tubuh. Meskipun mengalami penurunan, Imboost Force masih menjadi produk dengan kontribusi terbesar bagi bisnis Produk Profesional.

The Consumer Health segment recorded a decrease in net sales of 15.8% by year end, amounting to IDR 430.6 billion and contributing 5.3% to the group's total net sales. The Gross Profit Margin decreased to 68.8% in 2023 compared to 70.7% in the previous year, driven by a declining contribution from Imboost sales. This decline was affected by changes in consumer behaviour regarding the consumption of vitamins after the end of the Covid-19 pandemic and a sharp decline in sales of syrup format products due to national syrup safety issue that persisted until the first semester of 2023.

Net revenues from the Alliance segment increased by 11.9% compared to 2022. The increase was mainly due to and increase in sales of CNS products, as well as several new product launches in 2023.

Net revenues from the Others segment decreased by 45.1%, mainly due to a decrease in revenue from sales of medical devices and Unihealth products.

Segment Kesehatan konsumen mencatat penurunan penjualan bersih sebesar 15,8% pada akhir tahun, menjadi Rp 430,6 miliar dan berkontribusi sekitar 5,3% terhadap total penjualan bersih grup. Margin Laba Kotor turun menjadi 68,8% pada tahun 2023 dibandingkan dengan 70,7% pada tahun sebelumnya, didorong oleh penurunan kontribusi dari penjualan Imboost. Penurunan ini dipengaruhi oleh perubahan perilaku konsumen mengenai konsumsi vitamin setelah berakhirnya pandemi Covid-19 dan penurunan tajam penjualan produk dalam format sirup karena masalah keamanan sirup nasional yang berlanjut hingga semester pertama tahun 2023.

Pendapatan neto dari segmen Alliance meningkat 11,9% dibandingkan dengan tahun 2022. Peningkatan ini terutama disebabkan oleh peningkatan penjualan produk CNS, serta peluncuran beberapa produk baru pada tahun 2023.

Pendapatan neto dari Segmen Lainnya mengalami penurunan sebesar 45,1% terutama karena adanya penurunan pendapatan dari penjualan alat kesehatan dan produk-produk Unihealth.

## Receivables collectibility

At the end of 2023, the Company's accounts receivable collection period was 59 days, longer than the previous year's 53 days. It was mainly due to payments from government hospitals that were slower in 2023 compared to 2022 and 2021 as a result of a lower level of government funds allocated to the sector after the end of the Covid-19 emergency. Nevertheless, it remains within the normal range, and the Company continues to maintain operational discipline. All outstanding debts are short-term receivables.

The collectibility of receivables is reviewed periodically. Management has also conducted a review based on the status of each business receivable on each reporting date and is confident that the provision for impairment losses as described in Note 5 of the Financial Statements is adequate to cover any losses that may arise from uncollectible receivables.

## Liquidity

To ensure availability of sufficient cash, the Treasury Department prepares cash flow forecasts and maintains funding flexibility through adequate credit facility management.

The Company has a reasonably strong liquidity position, with cash and cash equivalent plus marketable securities of IDR 889.6 billion. At the end of 2023, the Company's current ratio was 1.89.

## Capital structure

The Company's capital structure policy is aligned with and comply to the prevailing tax regulations, whereas the maximum allowable DER for tax purposes is 4:1. At year end 2023, the Company did not have any bank loan or other interest-bearing debt instruments.

## Material commitments for investment in capital goods

In 2023, the Company did not have any material commitment for investment in capital goods.

## Tingkat kolektibilitas piutang

Pada akhir tahun 2023, periode penagihan piutang Perseroan (collection period) adalah 59 hari, lebih lama dibandingkan dengan 53 hari pada tahun sebelumnya. Hal ini terutama disebabkan oleh pembayaran dari rumah sakit pemerintah yang lebih lambat pada tahun 2023 dibandingkan dengan tahun 2022 dan 2021 sebagai akibat dari besaran dana pemerintah yang lebih rendah yang dialokasikan ke sektor ini setelah berakhirnya darurat Covid-19. Meskipun demikian, hal tersebut tetap berada dalam kisaran normal, dan Perusahaan terus menjaga disiplin operasional. Semua piutang yang masih belum lunas adalah piutang jangka pendek.

Kolektibilitas piutang ditinjau secara berkala. Manajemen juga telah melakukan penelaahan berdasarkan status masing-masing piutang usaha pada setiap tanggal pelaporan, dan berkeyakinan bahwa provisi atas kerugian penurunan nilai yang dijelaskan pada Catatan 5 Laporan Keuangan telah memadai untuk menutupi kerugian yang mungkin timbul dari piutang yang tidak tertagih.

Perseroan memiliki likuiditas yang cukup kuat dengan nilai kas dan setara kas ditambah surat berharga sebesar Rp 889,6 milyar. Rasio lancar Perseroan pada akhir tahun 2023 tercatat sebesar 1,89.

## Commitment to Good Corporate Governance Practices

Komitmen terhadap Praktik Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik

The Company is committed to operating at the highest standards of Good Corporate Governance. We want to ensure that everything our employees do is guided by our commitment to our values and is in compliance with the local laws and regulations. The foundations of these commitments are laid out in our Good Corporate Governance ("GCG") Code, which we established in October 2015 and has become the underpinning set of rules for management and employees. The GCG Code collects several key principles and provides a working guideline for how we apply our values across our operations. GCG practices are extremely important to the Company's ability to accomplish its goals.

The corporate governance (GCG) implementation has been carried out in accordance with the applicable laws and Company regulations. Each governing body operates independently and is responsible for its functions. Besides that, every decision taken has considered the GCG principles related to transparency, accountability, responsibility, independency, as well as equality and fairness.

These five principles of GCG help the Company to maintain a harmonious and ethical relationship with its shareholders and other stakeholders.

In addition, the implementation of GCG principles in business activities also support integrity, work ethics, and accountable decision-making through supervision, control activities and adequate risk management.

Based on this understanding, GCG becomes the reference for the Company to deal with the increasing competition and the uncertainties in business, while ensuring its long-term business continuity.

To enhance the implementation quality, the Company conducts evaluation and follow-up on improvements for the implementation of GCG across its entire portfolio of businesses.
