# Explanation of The Sustainability Strategy

Penjelasan Strategi Keberlanjutan

## Sustainability Strategy

We believe that sustainable entrepreneurship and profitable growth go hand in hand; we can only remain competitive by creating added value for all our stakeholders. We would be able to achieve this by hearing directly from them as to what are the matters that are the most important to them. Thus, in 2023, we have engaged Pricewaterhouse Coopers, a reputable and independent third-party to conduct our materiality analysis to objectively help us summarize the material drivers which are important to our stakeholders.

We conducted our materiality analysis through the help of Pricewaterhouse Coopers, a reputable and independent third-party who have been assisting objectively identify material drivers which are important to our stakeholders. This process involved reaching out to internal and external stakeholders to obtain their feedback on a range of relevant sustainability topics. After the survey data collection and calibration of results the sustainability broad themes and material topics were identified. We prioritized into 3 main core topics and 5 sub-topics which comprise our sustainability materiality arches.

## Strategi Keberlanjutan

Kami percaya bahwa kewirausahaan berkelanjutan dan pertumbuhan yang menguntungkan berjalan seiring; kita hanya bisa tetap kompetitif dengan menciptakan nilai tambah bagi seluruh pemangku kepentingan. Kita dapat mencapai hal ini dengan mendengar langsung dari mereka mengenai hal-hal apa saja yang paling penting bagi mereka. Dengan demikian, pada tahun 2023, kami telah melibatkan Pricewaterhouse Coopers, pihak ketiga yang bereputasi dan independen untuk melakukan analisis materialitas guna membantu kami merangkum faktor-faktor pendorong material yang penting bagi pemangku kepentingan kami secara objektif.

Kami melakukan analisis materialitas melalui bantuan Pricewaterhouse Coopers, pihak ketiga yang bereputasi dan independen yang telah membantu mengidentifikasi secara objektif pendorong material yang penting bagi pemangku kepentingan kami. Proses ini melibatkan upaya menjangkau pemangku kepentingan internal dan eksternal untuk mendapatkan umpan balik mereka mengenai berbagai topik keberlanjutan yang relevan. Setelah pengumpulan data survei dan kalibrasi hasilnya, tema-tema luas dan topik-topik penting keberlanjutan diidentifikasi. Kami memprioritaskan menjadi 3 topik inti utama dan 5 sub-topik yang membentuk rangkaian materialitas keberlanjutan kami.

![img-146.jpeg](img-146.jpeg)

The materiality diagram above will show what are the key sustainability areas which would be our focus. For us the first and foremost material topic is about keeping our employees engaged and satisfied which we want to achieve through continuous people development through formal and informal trainings, providing a conducive and safe working environment and providing competitive employee compensation and benefits. We believe that this result in an increased vigor in our employees which will lead to better service and satisfaction to our customers, who we aim to provide with the best products and services. The same customers that motivate us to keep on innovating our products and services to better cater to their needs. All of these activities are executed through with the support of a strong corporate governance framework.

Diagram materialitas di atas akan menunjukkan bidang keberlanjutan utama apa yang akan menjadi fokus kami. Bagi kami, topik penting yang pertama dan terpenting adalah menjaga keterlibatan dan kepuasan karyawan yang ingin kami capai melalui pengembangan sumber daya manusia yang berkelanjutan melalui pelatihan formal dan informal, menyediakan lingkungan kerja yang kondusif dan aman serta memberikan kompensasi dan tunjangan karyawan yang kompetitif. Kami percaya bahwa hal ini akan meningkatkan semangat karyawan kami yang akan menghasilkan layanan dan kepuasan yang lebih baik kepada pelanggan kami, yang ingin kami berikan produk dan layanan terbaik. Pelanggan yang sama yang memotivasi kami untuk terus berinovasi dalam produk dan layanan kami untuk memenuhi kebutuhan mereka dengan lebih baik. Seluruh aktivitas ini dilaksanakan dengan dukungan kerangka tata kelola perusahaan yang kuat.

Our first material topic is about keeping our employees engaged and satisfied which we want to achieve through continuous people development through formal and informal trainings, providing a conducive and safe working environment and providing competitive employee compensation and benefits. We put time and resources to develop our employees to prepare them to be ambassadors of our companies inside and outside of the work area.

Our second material topic is about making our customers happy and satisfied. We ensure products we produce are safe and will promote better health. We ensure that our products undergo a series of diligent quality testing and checks, both internally and by any necessary external parties, including regulators.

Our third material topic is about innovating products that would cater to what customer needs. Since lifestyle and other factors that affect the health or our customers are constantly changing, we identify and adopt to these factors in order for us to provide our customers what they need in this dynamic society.

Our fourth material topic is about our responsibility on the use and protection of our environment. We want to make as minimal environmental footprint in our activity by reducing our waste and utility usage which ultimately results to reduced carbon emissions which is contributing to climate change, the biggest environment threat that we faced today. Thus we are and will continue to do initiatives to monitor and reduce our Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions, with 2022 as our base year. We have established an ESG Committee, directly reporting to the Board which will assist the Board in managing the implementation and realization of our sustainability objectives, which includes achieving the Science Based reduction targets determined from the result of our Scope 1, 2 and 3 emission inventories.

Our fifth material topic is about having a strong corporate governance. We educate and train all our employees about Code of Ethics and Business Conduct in order to prepare them and how to properly act in the face of moral dilemmas. We provide a support platform (whistleblowing hotline) where actual and suspected violations can be reported without worry of retaliation. We set policy and procedures on how to handle violators.

These are the brief overview of our strategy in achieving our sustainability objectives. More details will be presented in the succeeding pages.

Topik materi kami yang pertama adalah menjaga keterlibatan dan kepuasan karyawan yang ingin kami capai melalui pengembangan sumber daya manusia yang berkelanjutan melalui pelatihan formal dan informal, menyediakan lingkungan kerja yang kondusif dan aman serta memberikan kompensasi dan tunjangan karyawan yang kompetitif. Kami meluangkan waktu dan sumber daya untuk mengembangkan karyawan kami guna mempersiapkan mereka menjadi duta perusahaan kami di dalam dan di luar tempat kerja.

Topik materi kami yang kedua adalah tentang membuat pelanggan senang dan puas. Kami memastikan produk yang kami hasilkan aman dan akan meningkatkan kesehatan. Kami memastikan bahwa produk kami menjalani serangkaian pengujian dan pemeriksaan kualitas yang cermat, baik secara internal maupun oleh pihak eksternal yang diperlukan, termasuk regulator.

Topik materi ketiga kami adalah tentang inovasi produk yang dapat memenuhi kebutuhan pelanggan. Karena gaya hidup dan faktor-faktor lain yang mempengaruhi kesehatan atau pelanggan kami terus berubah, kami mengidentifikasi dan mengadopsi faktor-faktor ini agar kami dapat menyediakan apa yang pelanggan kami butuhkan dalam masyarakat yang dinamis ini.

Topik materi kami yang keempat adalah tentang tanggung jawab kami terhadap pemanfaatan dan perlindungan lingkungan. # Overview of Sustainability Aspects

## Environment Friendly Innovation

Continuing the implementation of green technology in the business processes by maximizing the use of extracted waste to become compost, which is used in the curcuma plantation at the SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR) as organic fertilizer. SCEHR is maintaining its organic certification from the Indonesian Organic Farming Certification.

In developing new products, we do not use organic solvent for product coating. We also continue the use of organic solvents to water-based solvents for product coating in our existing products. Further, we reduced grammage of tertiary packaging in several packaging materials, which did not have a significant impact on packaging quality. For strip packaging, we continue by studying the possibility of using different specifications to reduce the grammage of aluminum foil, without affecting product quality.

## Partnership with Local Stakeholders

SOHO Global Health is committed to contributing to the socio-economic aspects of farmers and communities. We do this through the development of science and technology with academics through various extraction, pre-clinical (toxicity and efficacy) research and clinical trials and actively provide a resource person support to the "Kampus Merdeka" learning program, a program by the Ministry of Education and Culture which gives Universities the ability to provide courses and activities that would suit the interests of students outside of the standard curriculum. Several academics and institutions that have become research partners and Kampus Merdeka programs include the Faculty of Pharmacy and the Department of Chemical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, Gadjah Mada University, Yogyakarta; Faculty of Pharmacy, University of Indonesia, Depok; School of Pharmacy, Bandung Institute of Technology; Bogor Agricultural University; Udayana University Faculty of Medicine; as well as the National Research and Innovation Agency (BRIN). Through these various researches, several innovative products have been produced as well as scientific publications in both national and international journals.

Collaboration with communities around the SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR), such as the Dahlia Women Farmers Group still being done, including implementation of Smart Farming 4.0 which was initiated in 2020 and has been applied to all planted areas. We also encourage farmers to apply intercropping with sweet corn plants to help the farmers' have more income from crops. We conducted a research related to the cultivation of intercropping during the curcuma cultivation process, where the method of intercropping with sweet corn did not affect the quality of the curcuma produced. In fact intercropping was able to provide a positive impact for farmers, repeated land cultivation enriches the soil so that it gives a positive impact on curcuma cultivation.

## Inovasi Ramah Lingkungan

Penerapan beberapa teknologi hijau masih terus dilakukan dalam menjalankan proses bisnis kami dengan tetap memaksimalkan pemanfaatan limbah hasil ekstraksi menjadi kompos yang digunakan di kebun temulawak di SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR) sebagai pupuk organik. SCEHR akan selalu mempertahankan sertifikasi organiknya oleh Sertifikasi Pertanian Organik Indonesia.

Dalam pengembangan produk baru, kami tidak menggunakan pelarut organik sebagai bahan pelapis produk. Kami juga melanjutkan penggantian penggunaan pelarut organik ke pelarut berbasis air sebagai pelapisan produk untuk produk existing. Selanjutnya kami mengurangi gramsai kemasan tersier dari beberapa bahan kemasan kami, hal ini tidak berdampak signifikan terhadap kualitas kemasan. Dalam hal kemasan strip, kami melanjutkan dengan mempelajari kemungkinan untuk menggunakan spesifikasi yang berbeda sehingga dapat mengurangi gramsai alumunium foil, namun dengan tidak mempengaruhi kualitas produk.

## Kemitraan dengan Pemangku Kepentingan Lokal

SOHO Global Health berkomitmen untuk berkontribusi pada aspek sosial ekonomi petani dan masyarakat serta terlibat dalam pengembangan ilmu pengetahuan dan teknologi bersama akademisi melalui berbagai riset ekstraksi, pre klinik (toksisitas dan efikasi) serta uji klinik dan aktif menjadi narasumber pada program pembelajaran "Kampus Merdeka", sebuah program oleh Kementerian Pendidikan dan Kebudayaan yang memberikan hak kepada Universitas untuk menyediakan kursus dan kegiatan yang sesuai dengan minat siswa di luar standar kurikulum. Beberapa akademisi dan institusi yang menjadi mitra riset dan program Kampus Merdeka antara lain Fakultas Farmasi dan Departemen Teknik Kimia Fakultas Teknik Universitas Gadjah Mada Yogyakarta, Fakultas Farmasi Universitas Indonesia Depok, Sekolah Farmasi Institut Teknologi Bandung, Institut Pertanian Bogor, Fakultas Kedokteran Universitas Udayana, serta Badan Riset dan Inovasi Nasional (BRIN). Melalui berbagai riset tersebut telah dihasilkan beberapa produk inovatif serta publikasi ilmiah baik pada jurnal Nasional maupun International.

Kerjasama dengan masyarakat sekitar SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR) dalam hal ini dengan Kelompok Wanita Tani Dahlia masih tetap dilakukan, termasuk implementasi Smart Farming 4.0 yang telah dirintis sejak tahun 2020 dan telah diterapkan di seluruh area tanam. Kami juga mendorong petani untuk menerapkan tumpang sari dengan tanaman jagung manis untuk membantu petani mendapatkan lebih banyak pendapatan dari tanaman. Kami melakukan penelitian terkait budi daya tumpang sari selama proses budi daya temulawak, dimana metode tumpang sari dengan jagung manis tidak mempengaruhi kualitas temulawak yang dihasilkan. Bahkan tumpang sari tidak hanya mampu memberikan dampak positif bagi petani, penggarapan lahan secara berulang mampu menyuburkan tanah sehingga juga dapat memberikan dampak positif bagi budidaya temulawak.

In 2022 and continuing to 2023, SOHO Global Health developed the Seed to Patient concept for products made from Echinacea purpurea (L.) Moench. Although Echinacea is natively an herb from Europe with subtropical to temperate climates, the extensive use of Echinacea outside European countries including Indonesia, makes Echinacea one of the herbs that has been naturalized to become an endogenous Indonesian herb. By applying the concept of Academic, Business, Government and Community (ABGC) collaboration, we have collaborated with the Spice and Medicinal Plants Research Institute (Balittro) to obtain superior Echinacea seeds in Indonesia and also with the GAPOKTAN Dahlia farming community for their cultivation. As such, SOHO has succeeded in carrying out Cultivation of Echinacea purpurea on SCEHR land which is estimated to be carried out 2-3 times each growing season. Each growing season, the amount of Echinacea simplicia produced ranges from 0.25-0.5 kg per m². The Echinacea simplicia produced by SCEHR also has superior quality with active biomarker levels that have met or even exceeded the Echinacea simplicia quality standards set by the European Medicines Agency (EMA). Further collaboration with academics in testing the effectiveness of extracts as antioxidants, tests are carried out by determining the IC50 value of each extract. IC50 itself is defined as the concentration of antioxidant compounds needed to reduce radical activity by 50%, where a smaller value indicates higher activity. The test results showed that Echinacea purpurea extract from SCEHR had the best antioxidant effect compared to other Echinacea extract samples.

In 2023, we continued the Seed to Patient concept by conducting extraction experiments on Echinacea purpurea dry herbs to obtain a standardized dry extract which will further be used in our new products. As an initial stage, the results of the experiments that we conducted show prospective results. This experiment will continue in the following year until expected result are obtained.

In 2023, SOHO Global Health expanded its Academic, Business, Government, and Community (ABGC) collaboration by obtaining RISPRO (Innovative Research Production) 2023 funding from the LPDP (Education Fund Management Institution) - Ministry of Finance. The RISPRO program aims to generate breakthrough research innovations that emphasize in increasing national competitiveness, potentially increasing intellectual wealth and economic value, as well as practical applications of renewable technologies, ultimately contributing to the well-being of the Indonesian society.

SOHO Global Health is recognized as qualified by LPDP in terms of technological readiness, innovative ideas, and human resource capabilities thus we were awarded a RISPRO research grant for the development of innovative immunostimulant products based on native Indonesian herbs. For this RISPRO program, SOHO Global Health collaborates with Bogor Agricultural Institute (IPB) as a partner in conducting research, and farmers and local suppliers for the availability of raw materials.

Pada tahun 2022 dan berlanjut sampai tahun 2023, SOHO Global Health mengembangkan konsep proses pembibitan sampai ke pengguna untuk produk-produk berbahan Echinacea purpurea (L.) Moench. Echinacea walaupun secara native merupakan herbal dari Eropa yang beriklim subtropis hingga sedang, pemanfaatan Echinacea yang luas di luar negara-negara Eropa termasuk Indonesia, menjadikan Echinacea sebagai salah satu herbal yang telah dinaturalisasi menjadi herbal endogenous Indonesia. Dengan menerapkan konsep kolaborasi Academic, Business, Government, dan Community (ABGC), kolaborasi dengan Balai Penelitian Tanaman Rempah dan Obat (Balittro) untuk memperoleh bibit unggulan Echinacea yang ada di Indonesia dan juga dengan komunitas petani GAPOKTAN Dahlia untuk kultivasinya. Dengan demikian SOHO telah berhasil melakukan kultivasi Echinacea purpurea pada lahan SCEHR yang diperkirakan dapat dilakukan 2-3 kali musim tanam setiap tahunnya. Setiap musim tanam, jumlah simplisia Echinacea yang dihasilkan berkisar antara 0.25-0.5 kg per m². Simplisia Echinacea yang dihasilkan SCEHR pun memiliki kualitas unggul dengan kadar biomarker aktif yang telah memenuhi bahkan melampaui standar kualitas simplisia Echinacea yang ditetapkan European Medicines Agency (EMA). Kolaborasi lebih lanjut dengan akademisi dalam melakukan pengujian efektivitas ekstrak sebagai antioksidan, pengujian dilakukan dengan penentuan nilai IC50 dari masing-masing ekstrak. IC50 sendiri didefinisikan sebagai konsentrasi senyawa antioksidan yang dibutuhkan untuk mengurangi aktivitas radikal sebesar 50%, dimana nilai yang lebih kecil menunjukkan aktivitas yang lebih tinggi. Hasil pengujian menunjukan ekstrak Echinacea purpurea dari SCEHR memiliki efek antioksidan paling baik dibandingkan dengan sampel ekstrak Echinacea lainnya.

Tahun 2023, kami melanjutkan konsep proses pembibitan sampai ke pengguna dengan melakukan percobaan ekstraksi terhadap simplisia Echinacea purpurea untuk mendapatkan ekstrak kering yang terstandard dan lebih lanjut akan digunakan pada produk baru. Sebagai tahap awal, hasil percobaan yang kami lakukan menunjukkan hasil yang prospektif, namun percobaan ini masih akan terus disempurnakan.

Pada tahun 2023, SOHO Global Health memperluas kolaborasi Academic, Business, Government, dan Community (ABGC) dengan diperolehnya pendanaan RISPRO (Riset Inovatif Produksi) 2023 dari LPDP (Lembaga Pengelolaan Dana Pendidikan) - Kementrian Keuangan. Program RISPRO tersebut bertujuan untuk menghasilkan terobosan inovasi riset yang mengedepankan peningkatan daya saing nasional, berpotensi meningkatkan kekayaan intelektual dan bernilai ekonomis, ataupun teknologi terbarukan yang aplikatif, serta dapat membantu menyejahterakan masyarakat Indonesia.

SOHO Global Health dinilai layak oleh LPDP dari segi kesiapan teknologi, ide inovatif, dan kemampuan SDM sehingga diberikan research grant RISPRO untuk pengembangan produk inovatif imunostimulan berbasis herbal asli Indonesia. Untuk program RISPRO ini SOHO Global Health menggandeng Institut Pertanian Bogor (IPB) sebagai mitra dalam melakukan riset, dan petani serta supplier lokal untuk ketersediaan bahan bakunya.

# Cyber Security

Toward the inevitable digitalization era, we have placed high attention to cyber security, which is one of our important pillars to secure our business sustainability. We have a well-proven and tested security DRP (Disaster Recovery Plan) which is an inseparable element of our BCP (Business Continuation Plan). Understanding also the critical role that technology brings to our daily operations (from producing to distributing important medicine), quoting a well known security expert Rodolfo Assis that "A hacker only need to be lucky ONCE" we unquestionably have to put high effort in monitoring the environment all the time and all the way.

Dalam memproduksi produk-produknya, SIP berkomitmen untuk menggunakan bahan-bahan yang berasal dari dalam negeri. # Keamanan Siber

Menuju era digitalisasi yang tidak terhindarkan, SGH menaruh perhatian yang besar terhadap keamanan siber, yang adalah salah satu pilar penting untuk mengamankan keberlangsungan bisnis perusahaan kami. Kami memiliki Perencanaan Pemulihan Bencana (DRP) yang telah teruji untuk insiden keamanan siber, yang merupakan bagian tidak terpisahkan dari Perencanaan Keberlangsungan Perusahaan (BCP) kami. Mengingat industri farmasi termasuk salah satu industri yang paling banyak diserang oleh pelanggaran siber, kami dengan rajin melakukan perbaikan, seperti yang ditunjukkan oleh kartu skor keamanan kami yang saat ini berada di Kelas A dalam penilaian keamanan (berdasarkan kartu skor keamanan).

Memahami bahwa teknologi memiliki peran kritikal dalam proses bisnis SGH sehari-hari (dari proses produksi sampai distribusi obat), mengutip seorang ahli keamanan siber Rodolfo Assis bahwa "Seorang peretas hanya perlu SATU kesempatan saja" maka tidak perlu diragukan bahwa kami harus melakukan Upaya terbaik untuk memonitor seluruh lingkungan yang ada setiap waktu dan dengan segala cara yang memungkinkan.

A glimpse of what we are doing to manage the cyber security incidents is summarized on below diagram.

DEVICE - We regulate devices in the Company by a standard company device protocol controlled and managed by Business Technology Department. IDENTITY - We diligently implement MFA (Multi Factor Authentication) to all our applications and users.

APPLICATIONS - We have advance protections tools and real time monitoring of security threats.

Kami berhasil memiliki zero-day cyber attack dan menjaga ketahanan perusahaan dari serangan siber yang akan mengganggu keberlangsungan bisnis dan operasional sehari-hari dengan dukungan seluruh lapisan di dalam organisasi dan kapabilitas yang menyeluruh di bidang keamanan siber.

On October 31, 2023, PT Soho Industri Pharmasi (SIP) participated in the National Food and Drug Agency's (BPOM) Net Zero Carbon Program event. Participants in the event contributed in planting mangrove in Taman Wisata Alam Angke Kapuk and Ecowisata Mangrove Pantai Indah Kapuk in North Jakarta. This event will run for over a period of 3 years and SIP will plant 300 trees over this period.

![img-154.jpeg](img-154.jpeg)

Mangrove conservation has various benefits, such as protecting against erosion and natural disasters, controlling water and air pollution, reducing greenhouse gas emissions, providing potential natural resources, and maintaining ecosystem balance and health.

# Energy Consumption from Factory

We need energy sources to carry out our production activities, including Diesel Fuel, Natural Gas, and Electricity from the State Electricity Company (PLN). Electricity from PLN is the main energy source for our operating machineries, tools, equipment, and Air Handling Units. Energy from diesel fuel is used for Electricity Generator and Fire Pump and Natural Gas is used to operate steam boilers.

## GHG (Greenhouse Gas) Emission Control in Response to Climate Change

Climate change and global warming are problems that must be addressed by everyone. To that end, Soho Global Health contributes to curbing the extreme rate of climate change. This initiative supports the Government of Indonesia's commitment after they ratified the Paris Agreement. Climate change, including greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions poses a potential risk of reducing the availability of herbal raw materials for our products. To maintain the sustainability of existing herbal raw materials from local suppliers, we continue to provide guidance to the curcuma farmers regarding climate change and sustainable ecosystem management.

We ensure that the management of all direct emissions from boiler operations, machine production and standby generators always comply with regulatory requirements. This is achieved by conducting routine tool maintenance, regular emission levels testing, and reporting to the Environment Agency every six months. Our initiatives to reduce GHG emissions also includes planning of initiative for the renewable energy mix to make it cleaner, more sustainable, and free from carbon emissions. Tree planting and landscape greening in the factory areas also contributes to absorbing  $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$  from the surrounding environment.

In 2023, we have engaged Schneider Electric to assist us in our initiative for Net Zero Emission by developing our Science Based Targets and developing a Decarbonization Roadmap. We have identified our Scope 1, 2 & 3 reduction targets using the absolute reductions approach.

## Pengendalian Emisi GRK (Gas Rumah Kaca) sebagai Tanggapan atas Perubahan Iklim

Perubahan iklim dan pemanasan global merupakan masalah yang harus ditanggulangi oleh seluruh elemen masyarakat. Untuk itu, Soho Global Health juga turut berkontribusi dalam menekan laju perubahan iklim yang ekstrim. Inisiatif ini mendukung komitmen Pemerintah Indonesia setelah meratifikasi Paris Agreement. Perubahan iklim, termasuk emisi Gas Rumah Kaca (GRK) berpotensi menurunkan ketersediaan bahan baku herbal untuk produk kami. Untuk menjaga keberlanjutan bahan baku herbal yang ada dari pemasok lokal, kami terus melakukan pembinaan kepada para petani temulawak mengenai perubahan iklim dan pengelolaan ekosistem yang berkelanjutan.

Kami memastikan bahwa pengelolaan semua emisi langsung dari operasi boiler, mesin produksi, dan generator siaga selalu memenuhi peraturan saat ini. Hal ini dicapai dengan mempertahankan penggunaan alat yang tepat, pengujian tingkat emisi secara teratur, dan pelaporan ke Badan Lingkungan Hidup setiap enam bulan sekali. Inisiatif kami untuk mengurangi emisi GRK juga mencakup perencanaan inisiatif pengunaan energi terbarukan agar lebih bersih, lebih berkelanjutan, dan bebas dari emisi karbon. Penanaman pohon dan penghijauan lanskap di area pabrik juga berkontribusi dalam menyerap  $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$  dari lingkungan sekitar.

Di 2023, kami telah melibatkan Schneider Electric untuk membantu kami dalam inisiatif Net Zero Emission dengan mengembangkan Target Berbasis Sains dan mengembangkan Dekarbonisasi Roadmap. Kami telah mengidentifikasi target pengurangan Ruang Lingkup 1, 2 & 3 menggunakan pendekatan pengurangan absolut.

## Efficiency Strategies

a. Electricity - Optimizing and improving the production process to increase productivity and energy efficiency.
b. Water - Monitoring usage and leaks in pipelines and storage tank.
c. Gas - Efficiently using the steam boilers.

Some of the initiatives that have been performed:

- Replacement of chiller pipe insulation to minimize loss of cooling energy generated from the chiller generator. By replacing the chiller insulation, we can minimize cooling leaks in the chiller water distribution line thereby reducing energy consumption.
- Replacement of chiller condenser to optimize cooling capacity, thus reducing energy consumption.

## Strategi Efisiensi

a. Listrik - Mengoptimalkan dan memperbaiki proses produksi untuk meningkatkan produktifitas dan efisiensi energi.
b. Air - Pemantauan penggunaan dan kebocoran pada pipa dan tangki penyimpanan.
c. Gas - Menggunakan ketel uap secara efisien.

Beberapa inisiatif yang telah dilakukan:

- Penggantian isolasi pipa pendingin untuk meminimalkan kehilangan energi pendinginan yang dihasilkan dari generator pendingin. Dengan mengganti isolasi pendingin, kita dapat meminimalkan kebocoran pendinginan di jalur distribusi air pendingin sehingga mengurangi konsumsi energi.
- Penggantian kondensor chiller agar pendinginan kondensor optimal sehingga mengurangi penggunaan energi.

- Installing an inverter on chiller water circulation pump so that it can reduce energy consumption when the AHU is not running at full capacity.
- Replacement of non-LED Tubular lamps with LED type, as this type is more energy efficient.
- Replacement of city water pipes which were previously made of metal and had the potential to leak because the pipes are old and corroded, replaced with HDPE to minimize leaks.
- Carry out routine maintenance on boiler generators and steam distribution lines so that the use of gas fuel becomes efficient.

## Waste Management

Our waste is managed based on the type and material content, which is comprised of solid and liquid waste, and hazardous and toxic, and non-hazardous materials. Our waste management is carried in collaboration with licensed third parties.

Liquid waste is managed through the Waste Water Management Installation (IPAL). We ensure that run-off water meets Government established quality standards before being released into bodies of water, or channelled for further processing by industrial estate managers. Waste water quality monitoring is carried out internally and externally and involves an environmental laboratory accredited by the National Accreditation Committee (NAC) and registered with the Ministry of Environment and Forestry (MoEF). Their inspection results are routinely reported to the City/District Environmental Agency and the Provincial Environmental Management Agency and the MoEF.

The management of non-hazardous material solid waste follows the 3R principle; reduce, reuse, and recycle. The hazardous material waste management is entrusted to third parties authorized by the MoEF in accordance with the applicable regulations. Business units participating in the PROPER Program use an electronic-based hazardous material waste reporting system making the traceability process easier and more accurate.

## Amount of Waste Water

- Pemasangan inverter pada pompa sirkulasi air chiller sehingga dapat menurunkan konsumsi energi saat penggunaan AHU tidak pada kapasitas full.
- Mengganti lampu berbentuk tabung yang belum LED dengan tipe LED, karena tipe ini lebih hemat energi.
- Penggantian pipa air PAM yang tadinya berbahan logam dan potensi bocor karena pipa sudah termakan usia serta terjadi korosi, digantikan dengan pipa HDPE untuk meminimalisir kebocoran.
- Melakukan perawatan rutin pada generator boiler dan jalur distribusi steam sehingga penggunaan bahan bakar gas menjadi efisien.

## Penanganan limbah

Limbah kami dikelola berdasarkan jenis dan kandungan bahannya, meliputi limbah padat dan cair, serta Bahan Berbahaya dan Beracun (B3), dan bukan B3. Pengelolaan limbah kami dilakukan secara mandiri, atau bekerja sama dengan pihak ketiga yang memiliki izin.

Limbah cair dikelola melalui Instalasi Pengolahan Air Limbah (IPAL). Kami memastikan bahwa air limpasan memenuhi kualitas yang ditetapkan. Pemerintah baku sebelum dibuang ke badan air, atau dialirkan untuk diproses lebih lanjut oleh pengelola kawasan industri. Pemantauan kualitas air limbah dilakukan secara internal dan eksternal dan melibatkan laboratorium lingkungan yang terakreditasi oleh Komite Akreditasi Nasional (KPA) dan terdaftar di Kementerian Lingkungan Hidup dan Kehutanan (KLHK). Hasil pengawasan mereka secara rutin dilaporkan ke Kota/Kabupaten Badan Lingkungan Hidup dan Badan Pengelolaan Lingkungan Hidup Provinsi dan KLHK.

Pengelolaan limbah padat bukan B3 mengikuti prinsip 3R; mengurangi, menggunakan kembali, dan mendaur ulang. Pengelolaan limbah B3 dipercayakan kepada pihak ketiga yang diberi wewenang oleh KLHK sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku. Unit bisnis yang berpartisipasi dalam Program PROPER menggunakan sistem pelaporan limbah B3 berbasis elektronik, sehingga proses penelusuran lebih mudah dan lebih akurat.

Efforts to Reduce Waste

Upaya Mengurangi Limbah

Hazardous waste management is conducted through a Waste Management Procedure (procedure for handling hazardous and non-hazardous waste, starting from the handover of waste generators, storage of waste, handover to third parties, and emergency handling). All operational activities within the Hazardous Waste Temporary Storage are monitored through the Waste Balance Sheet Reports and Waste Record. This is to ensure that the amount of incoming hazardous waste matches the amount of hazardous waste handed over to a waste management agency that has a permit from the Ministry of Environment and Forestry. The Waste Balance is an integral part of mandatory reporting to the Ministry as part of environmental compliance. The initial processing of the waste generated and the optimization of the production process also contributes to reducing hazardous waste produced (pre-treatment, crushing, washing, compressing and as a mixture for animal food).

The research and development department continues to carry out innovative initiatives develop environmentally friendly products. Such as removing leaflets and just putting all the necessary product information on the product box. This initiative has been implemented for several new products from their launching. This had a big impact in terms of reducing paper use, including amount of waste produced.

The Production Department has made improvement in capsule filling process by optimizing the thickness of the dosing disk, thereby reducing product rejects during packaging and reducing reject of packaging materials.

Improvement effort was also done in tableting process of effervescent tablet to minimize rejects and increase product yield.

Other department, such as Quality Control and Quality Assurance are also contributing to support waste reduction. Simplification of analysis process to speed up analysis time and reduce the use of reagent (less waste) and energy usage.

Other improvement includes reducing the use of paper by developing digitalization system, such as in Change Control System (ICCS - Integrated Change Control System), Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), Calibration and Reagent Inventory Management System (Quality Laboratory Inventory System - Q-LIS) and Deviation Report Integrated System.

As part of SGH's CSR objectives to support children's literacy in Indonesia, particularly in Eastern Indonesia, since 2022 and continuing into 2023 and beyond, SGH is committed to supporting the improvement of children's literacy in Sumba through collaboration with the EGK Sumba Foundation via the Share the Books: Hope for Sumba hope for Indonesia program.

## Hope for Sumba Hope for Indonesia program: SGH x English Goes to Kampung (EGK) Sumba together fights for children literacy

SGH supports English learning activities for school-age children in Sumba organized by the English Goes to Kampung (EGK) Sumba community in Lamboya village, Laboya Bawa, West Sumba through the Share the Books program: Hope for Sumba Hope for Indonesia.

In the midst of the challenging conditions in West Sumba, where schools are poorly equipped and access to books is limited, the donations and acts of kindness from Soho Global Health (SGH) colleagues mean a great deal to the local children. Reading books, stationery, learning tools, and monetary donations are all greatly appreciated. Books serve as a window to the world, helping children at EGK Sumba learn about the world and build their dreams.

The children and youth of Sumba are the future generations of the island, particularly in the tourism sector, which relies heavily on foreign visitors. Therefore, it is crucial to provide English language learning resources to the youth in Sumbanese villages. In 2015, a humanitarian and literacy activist named Roswita Asti Kulla initiated English Goes to Kampung (EGK) Sumba, which has since reached over 1,000 Sumbanese children. However, there is still a long way to go to achieve the foundation's mission of making education accessible on Sumba Island.

Dalam rangka memenuhi salah satu tujuan CSR SGH untuk mendukung literasi anak-anak Indonesia, khususnya di Indonesia Timur, sejak tahun 2022 dan berlanjut ke tahun 2023 dan seterusnya, SGH berkomitmen untuk mendukung peningkatan literasi anak-anak di Sumba melalui kerjasama dengan Yayasan EGK Sumba lewat program Share the Books: Hope for Sumba hope for Indonesia.

## Hope for Sumba Hope for Indonesia program: SGH x English Goes to Kampung (EGK) Sumba berjuang bersama untuk literasi

SGH mendukung kegiatan belajar bahasa Inggris bagi anak-anak usia sekolah di Sumba yang diselenggarakan oleh komunitas English Goes to Kampung (EGK) Sumba di desa Lamboya, Laboya Bawa, Sumba Barat melalui program Share the Books: Hope for Sumba Hope for Indonesia.

Di tengah kondisi Sumba Barat yang sulit dijangkau, kondisi sekolah yang kurang memadai dan keterbatasan terhadap akses buku bacaan, donasi dan kepedulian rekan-rekan Soho Global Health (SGH) yang berbagi buku bacaan, alat tulis, alat bantu belajar, dan donasi dana sungguh sangat berarti bagi mereka. Sungguh buku adalah jendela dunia, melalui buku, anak-anak di EGK Sumba mulai mengenal dunia, dan memberanikan diri membangun impian.

Anak-anak dan pemuda Sumba, menjadi generasi masa depan Sumba, khususnya di sektor pariwisata yang mengandalkan wisatawan manca negara. Ada kebutuhan mendasar untuk menyediakan sumber daya belajar bahasa Inggris bagi para pemuda desa di Sumba. Sejak tahun 2015, English Goes to Kampung (EGK) Sumba diinisiasi oleh seorang penggerak kemanusiaan dan penggiat literasi, Roswita Asti Kulla, memulai dari kelas kecil di pesisir pantai. Hari ini, Yayasan ini telah menjangkau lebih dari 1.000 anak Sumba. Namun perjuangan masih panjang untuk mewujudkan misi komunitas ini: membuat pendidikan dapat diakses secara menyeluruh di Pulau Sumba.

"Education is a right, not a privilege", and it is our responsibility to ensure that every child becomes literate. Every child, regardless of their economic situation, deserves an equal opportunity to access education and pursue their dreams.

"Pendidikan adalah hak, bukan sebuah keistimewaan", dan adalah bagian dari tanggungjawab kita untuk memastikan setiap anak "melek" literasi. Bagaimanapun keadaan ekonomi mereka saat ini, setiap anak harus punya kesempatan yang sama atas akses pendidikan dan membangun harapan untuk mewujudkan impian mereka.

## Community Development

Our CSR programs in community development are carried out in collaboration with various agricultural institutions and researchers, as well as Community Health Center ("Puskesmas") and Nagrak sub-district to provide support to local programs including stunting alleviation and Open Defecation Free (ODF) program in Nagrak Village, Sukabumi Regency, West Java, the area around our herbal research facility, the SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR).

Realizing our commitment to have a greater impact on the environment and society, the Sukabumi community development program is not only focused on providing knowledge and cultivation method to local temulawak farmers, but also on offering a strategic partnership that aims to sustain economic value. We provide the necessary support to increase productivity and yields, as well as to ensure long-term market access for the temulawak harvest in coordination with the "Gapoktan Dahlia Sukabumi". This partnership benefits SGH in securing supply of consistently high quality raw materials for the production of curcuma-based products, while improving the economic welfare of the local farmers near the SCEHR plantation.

## Pengembangan Komunitas

Program CSR kami di bidang pengembangan masyarakat dilaksanakan dengan kolaborasi berbagai institusi pertanian dan peneliti, serta Pusat Kesehatan Masyarakat (Puskesmas) dan Kecamatan Nagrak untuk memberikan dukungan pada program-program lokal, termasuk program penanganan stunting dan program Bebas Buang Air Besar Sembarangan (Open Defecation Free/ODF) di Desa Nagrak, Kabupaten Sukabumi, Jawa Barat, daerah sekitar fasilitas penelitian herbal kami, SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR).

Mewujudkan komitmen kami untuk memberi dampak pada lingkungan dan masyarakat, program pemberdayaan masyarakat di Sukabumi ini tidak hanya terbatas pada pembekalan ilmu dan metode pembudidayaan untuk petani temulawak, namun juga menawarkan kemitraan strategis yang bertujuan menghasilkan nilai ekonomi jangka panjang. # Challenges and actions towards sustainability implementation

As our production levels are projected to grow, achieving our total waste and carbon reduction target becomes a challenge. Our core value "passion for innovation" had pushed us to innovate our ways and activities from the product formulation to the production stage. We have revisited our testing processes in order to expedite the process and reduce the unnecessary use of reagents during the analysis process. We also have been innovating on ways to reduce product and packaging rejections by making more durable and element resistant packaging. Considering the environmental factors and the process from product distribution and storage, we have noted the common cause of product damage and spoilage and we have made our product packaging adaptable to those factors.

We are also performing a pre-treatment process to reduce our toxic waste output. Our pre-treatment activities resulted in a significant reduction of our toxic waste output.

This increase in production level comes with the corresponding increase in energy consumption. We perform constant facility and equipment maintenance in order to ensure that emissions our facilities and equipment are at the minimum. We have also explored options for renewable energy, currently we have engaged a vendor to start the installation of solar panels in our factory.

# Sustainability Governance

## Tata Kelola Keberlanjutan

### Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners duties on sustainable finance

Soho Global Health is committed towards having a sound integrated corporate governance, which includes the topic of environment, social and governance. We have established an ESG Executive Committee (ESGEC), led by our CEO who supervises the execution of our ESG Management System and assess the adequacy of resources allocated for achieving our ESG objectives and goals. Reporting to the ESGEC, is the ESG Functional Committee (ESGFC), which is led by four ESG officers who are monitoring and coordinating all ESG related company initiatives. Quarterly and monthly meetings are held by the ESGEC and ESGFC, respectively to discuss on the status and updates of the outstanding sustainability initiatives of the group.

We have established an ESG Committee which is composed on an Executive and a Functional Committee. The former will supervise and monitor the agreed actions on our sustainability initiatives while the latter will ensure the proper and timely implementations of the agreed actions. The Functional Committee meets on a monthly basis while the Executive Committee meets on a quarterly basis to align with the Functional Committee, prior to the quarterly reporting and presentation to the Board.

### Competencies development for the Board of Directors regarding to sustainability

Our Board of Directors and Commissioners attend seminars and updates on topics about building a sustainable business. Some of our board members even have experiences in implementing sustainability initiatives in other local and cross border companies. Our board members attend or are provided with applicable sustainability trainings by internal and external parties to help keep them up to date with the current and emerging mega trends and regulations.

### Monitor and Control of Sustainable Finance Effectivity

We have established comprehensive policies, standard operating procedures and work instructions in order to have a clear guidance on how we should run our businesses. These policies and procedures are reviewed and approved by all the process owners and by the corresponding board member/s and/or the President Director. These policies and procedures are then checked for proper execution by our Internal Audit division who reports to the Board on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis regarding the implementation of the policies and procedures. Internal Audit also communicates improvement areas and actions to the Board for review and approval.

Some of our key policies include: (a) anti-bribery and corruption; (b) insider trading; (c) IT and infrastructure security policy; (d) personal data privacy protection; and (e) marketing practices for interaction with healthcare professionals, organizations and institutions. These are some of the policies that we uphold.

### Tugas Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris di bidang keuangan Keberlanjutan

Soho Global Health berkomitmen untuk memiliki tata kelola perusahaan terintegrasi yang sehat, yang mencakup topik lingkungan, sosial, dan tata kelola. Kami telah membentuk Komite Eksekutif ESG (ESGEC), yang dipimpin oleh CEO kami yang mengawasi pelaksanaan Sistem Manajemen ESG kami dan menilai kecukupan sumber daya yang dialokasikan untuk mencapai tujuan dan sasaran ESG kami. Melaporkan ke ESGEC, adalah ESG Functional Committee (ESGFC), yang dipimpin oleh empat petugas ESG yang memantau dan mengkoordinasikan semua inisiatif perusahaan terkait ESG. Pertemuan triwulanan dan dua bulanan masing-masing diadakan oleh ESGEC dan ESGFC untuk membahas status dan pembaruan inisiatif keberlanjutan dari grup.

Kami telah membentuk Komite ESG yang terdiri dari Komite Eksekutif dan Fungsional. Yang pertama akan mengawasi dan memantau tindakan yang disepakati dalam inisiatif keberlanjutan kami, sementara yang kedua akan memastikan implementasi yang tepat dan tepat waktu dari tindakan yang disepakati. Komite Fungsional bertemu setiap bulan sedangkan Komite Eksekutif bertemu setiap triwulan untuk menyelaraskan dengan Komite Fungsional, sebelum pelaporan dan presentasi triwulanan kepada Dewan.

## Recognizing and Respecting Employees' Rights

### Human Rights

As a company engaged in the health care industry, SGH believes that business has a responsibility to respect human rights and consistently makes every effort to uphold human rights within the company. Therefore, the company has a policy as a guideline for all employees to respect and prioritize human rights as an inseparable right and uphold for the sake of honor and protection of human dignity in relations between employees, external parties and society.

The Company is committed that human rights violations are illegal and we have zero-tolerance on it. The company makes every effort to ensure that there is no discrimination or business practices that are contrary to human rights, and takes steps to identify and prevent risks of human rights violations in business. During 2022 and 2023 there were no human rights violation case at SGH, either by employees or external parties.

The company's efforts to protect human rights among others:

1.  Prohibition of Child Labor

The company prohibits to employ children under the age of 18 (eighteen) years, and this minimum age is used as requirement in recruitment.

2.  Prohibition of Forced Labor and Human Trafficking

The company prohibits all forms of forced labor practices, including forced contract workers, modern forced labor, and all forms of human trafficking.

3.  Prohibition of Harassment and Intimidation

All levels of management and employees are prohibited from discriminating against employees who file complaints of harassment and intimidation. The company and its employees are committed and responsible for preventing acts of harassment and intimidation by maintaining good and productive industrial relations, socialization of policy and regulations applicable to the company, fair employment practices and respectful communication in the workplace.

## Mengakui dan Menghormati Hak-Hak Karyawan

### Hak Asasi Manusia

Sebagai perusahaan yang bergerak di industri kesehatan, SGH meyakini bahwa bisnis memiliki tanggung jawab dalam menghormati Hak Asasi Manusia (HAM) dan secara konsisten mendukung upaya-upaya penegakan HAM di lingkungan Perusahaan. Oleh karena itu perusahaan memiliki kebijakan khusus yang digunakan sebagai pedoman bagi seluruh karyawan untuk menghormati dan mengedepankan HAM sebagai hak yang tidak terpisahkan dari manusia dan ditegakkan demi kehormatan serta perlindungan harkat dan martabat manusia dalam hubungan antar karyawan, pihak eksternal serta masyarakat sekitar.

Perusahaan berkomitmen bahwa pelanggaran HAM merupakan tindakan ilegal dan tidak dapat ditolerir (zero-tolerance). Perusahaan berupaya maksimal untuk memastikan tidak terjadi diskriminasi ataupun praktik bisnis yang bertentangan dengan HAM, serta mengambil langkah-langkah untuk mengidentifikasi dan mencegah risiko pelanggaran HAM dalam bisnis. Selama tahun 2022 dan 2023 tidak terjadi pelanggaran HAM di SGH, baik oleh karyawan maupun pihak eksternal.

Langkah-langkah perusahaan dalam melindungi HAM antara lain meliputi:

1.  Larangan Tenaga Kerja Anak

Perusahaan melarang mempekerjakan anak di bawah usia 18 (delapan belas) tahun, dan batasan usia ini dijadikan sebagai syarat minimal usia penerimaan karyawan.

2.  Larangan Kerja Paksa dan Jual Beli Manusia

Perusahaan melarang segala bentuk praktek kerja paksa, termasuk tenaga kontrak paksa, model perbudakan modern dan segala bentuk jual beli manusia.

3.  Larangan Tindakan Pelecehan dan Intimidasi

Seluruh jajaran manajemen dan karyawan dilarang melakukan diskriminasi terhadap karyawan yang mengajukan pengaduan terjadinya tindakan pelecehan dan intimidasi. Perusahaan dan karyawan berkomitmen dan bertanggung jawab untuk mencegah terjadinya tindakan pelecehan dan intimidasi dengan cara menjaga hubungan industrial yang baik dan produktif, sosialisasi kebijakan dan peraturan yang berlaku di perusahaan, praktik ketenagakerjaan yang adil dan komunikasi penuh hormat di tempat kerja.

## Ecosystem and Environmental Preservation

SOHO environmental management policy complies with laws and environmental protection commitments, as stipulated in its Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE Policy). Environmental management practices and implementation are also regulated in the HSE Manual.

To ensure its environmental performance is in accordance with the predetermined policies, SOHO encourages business entities, especially production operation units, to implement the Environmental Management System in accordance with ISO 14001:2015.

Perusahaan juga berkomitmen dalam menghormati hak-hak ketenagakerjaan sebagai salah satu perwujudan HAM bagi karyawan, yaitu:

a. Memenuhi hak ketenagakerjaan.
b. Menghormati hubungan kerja dengan karyawan, khususnya dalam hal kejelasan status karyawan, penempatan kerja, penerimaan karyawan baru, mutasi, rotasi, promosi, dan demosi.
c. Menghormati hak karyawan untuk memiliki kesehatan yang baik, hari dan jam kerja yang jelas, kesempatan untuk cuti sakit, cuti haid, melahirkan, keguguran, cuti bersama, dan cuti tahunan.
d. Memberikan kesempatan yang setara dan non-diskriminatif serta menghargai keberagaman dan perbedaan.
e. Menghormati hak karyawan untuk berserikat dan berkumpul, serta bernegosiasi melalui serikat pekerja atau wakil pekerja.
f. Memberikan fasilitas sosial kepada seluruh karyawan sesuai kemampuan perusahaan.
g. Menyediakan tempat kerja yang bebas dari segala bentuk pelecehan dan intimidasi, dan memfasilitasi karyawan dalam menyampaikan dan menyelesaikan keluh kesah.
h. Memastikan keselamatan dan kesehatan karyawan dengan menyediakan tempat kerja yang aman, sehat, dan produktif.

Perusahaan juga mengharapkan agar pihak eksternal dan pemangku kepentingan lainnya berperan serta dalam menjunjung komitmen perusahaan terkait HAM dan mendorong mereka untuk menerapkan kebijakan yang sama dalam perusahaan mereka.

Emission Control

Soho Global Health uses boilers in its business and factory production activities that emit Nitrate Dioxide (NO₂), Sulphur Dioxide (SO₂), and other particulates. The emissions released are the result of burning fossil fuels and can disrupt the environmental quality and human health. Realizing this, we control our emissions by increasing the effectiveness of our boiler performance.

We also use environmentally friendly refrigerants in our air conditioning in the factories, warehouses and offices. Environmentally friendly materials are also being used with minimal ozone depletion potential (ODP) levels.

Other emission control efforts carried out include vehicle emission testing by workshops under the supervision of the Environmental Department. Test results in 2023 showed that all our operational vehicles have passed the emission tests, and confirmed that the emission levels were below the threshold.

Renewable Energy Innovations

We have started exploring Renewable Energy, PV/Solar Panel system installations were made in our Factory and Central Logistics. These installations will generate a total capacity of 654 kWp. The estimated annual emission reduction would be around 750 tCOe. This emissions reduction is equivalent to planting 1,200 trees every year.

On October 31, 2023, a symbolic inauguration for the Solar Cell System Project held between PT Soho Global Health and PT Ditrolic ATW Energi, as the project partner. Having implemented the use of renewable energy, we are proud to contribute in the battle against climate change and global warming.

Kontrol Emisi

Soho Global Health menggunakan ketel uap dalam kegiatan bisnis dan produksi pabriknya yang mengeluarkan Nitrat Dioksida (NO₂), Sulfur Dioksida (SO₂), dan partikulat lainnya. Menyadari hal tersebut, kami mengontrol emisi dengan meningkatkan efektivitas kinerja ketel uap.

Kami juga menggunakan pendingin ramah lingkungan dalam pendingin udara di pabrik, gudang dan kantor. Bahan ramah lingkungan juga digunakan dengan tingkat potensi penipisan ozon (ODP) yang minimal.

Kami menyediakan platform yang memudakan bagi masyarakat/konsumen untuk menyampaikan keluhan kepada kami melalui website www.sohoglobalhealth.com, email public.relations@sohoglobalhealth.com, dan media sosial (Facebook: SOHO Natural; Instagram: @sohonatural dan Youtube: Soho Natural).

Sebagai bagian dari komitmen kami terhadap keamanan produk dan sesuai dengan persyaratan peraturan, kami memiliki sistem pelaporan farmakovigilans. Semua laporan efek samping yang diterima perusahaan harus dilaporkan kepada tim farmakovigilans dalam waktu 24 jam secara lisan dan/atau tertulis melalui email pv@sohoglobalhealth.com. Perseroan akan menindaklanjuti pengaduan dari masyarakat/konsumen dan dimonitor status penyelesaiannya.

Pada tahun 2023, terdapat 12 keluhan yang diterima dari 10 produk terkait kejadian tidak dinginkan. Keluhan-keluhan tersebut telah diinvestigasi dan ditindaklanjuti sesuai prosedur yang berlaku, dimana keluhan-keluhan tersebut pada umumnya adalah kejadian tidak diinginkan yang bersifat non serius terkait dengan reaksi alergi, rasa mual, dan gangguan pencernaan yang bersifat ringan. Setelah menghentikan penggunaan produk, keluhan tersebut berangsur-angsur hilang dan kondisi pasien membaik.

Safety Evaluated Products/Services for Customers

We are committed to providing and offering good quality and safe products for our customers. Before being distributed to the market, all products have gone through various stages of very strict evaluation by the National Agency of Drug and Food Control (NA-DFC) so that these products are guaranteed in terms of safety, efficacy, and quality. We ensure that every product to be distributed has passed the evaluation and has obtained a distribution permit from the NA-DFC. Each production batch that is circulated has met the requirements for testing, monitoring, and product release carried out by our Quality Assurance (QA) Division. In addition, we also carry out routine pharmacovigilance activities for products that have been circulated to the market. Pharmacovigilance activities aim to monitor side effects and unwanted events that may occur due to the use of the product.

## Product Recall

In 2023, we conducted 2 product recalls. There were no incidents nor impacts to safety prior to and after the recalls.

## Seed to Patient Process

We continue to innovate in various aspects. One of the initiatives related to our product development is making a breakthrough in herbal medicine based on curcuma, starting from providing quality extract raw materials, testing the efficacy and safety in manufacturing the final product, to product innovation with better technology.

With 2 innovation concepts, namely the Seed to Patient concept and the collaboration concept of 4 components: Academic, Business, Government, and Community (ABGC), we have advantages in terms of controlled quality, proven usefulness and wide impact. In an effort to increase our independence of procuring superior quality raw materials, we came up with a Seed to Patient concept where every stage of the process is strictly controlled.

We implement green technology in carrying out our business processes. The application of green technology applied includes maximizing the use of extracted waste to become compost which use in the Curcuma plantation of the SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR) as organic fertilizer, and since 2017 SCEHR has also been certified organic from the Indonesian Organic Farming Certification.

Innovations in the product development process with green technology include the use of water-based coating media and no longer using organic solvent-based coating media. The comprehensive implementation of the water-based coating media on our products was able to reduce 100% of the impact of the risk of organic solvent contamination on the environment and also the risk of exposure to organic solvents of our employees.

## Produk/Jasa yang Sudah Dievaluasi Keamanannya bagi Pelanggan

Kami berkomitmen untuk menyediakan dan menawarkan produk yang berkualitas baik dan aman bagi para pelanggan kami. Sebelum diedarkan ke pasar, semua produk telah melalui berbagai tahapan evaluasi yang sangat ketat oleh Badan POM sehingga produk tersebut terjamin secara keamanan, efikasi, dan mutu. Kami memastikan bahwa setiap produk yang akan diedarkan telah lulus evaluasi dan telah memperoleh surat izin edar dari Badan POM. Setiap bets produksi yang diedarkan telah memenuhi persyaratan untuk pengujian, pengawasan, dan perilisan produk yang dilakukan oleh Divisi Pemastian Mutu (Quality Assurance, QA). Selain itu, kami turut melakukan kegiatan farmakovigilans secara rutin untuk produk-produk yang telah diedarkan ke pasar. Aktivitas farmakovigilans bertujuan untuk melakukan monitoring efek samping dan kejadian tidak diinginkan yang mungkin terjadi akibat penggunaan produk.

## Produk yang Ditarik Kembali

Pada tahun 2023, kami melakukan 2 kali penarikan produk. Tidak ada insiden atau dampak terhadap keselamatan sebelum dan sesudah penarikan.

## Proses Pembibitan sampai ke Pengguna

Kami terus melakukan inovasi pada berbagai aspek. Salah satu yang dilakukan terkait pengembangan produk kami mengadakan terobosan pada obat herbal berbasis temulawak, mulai dari penyediaan bahan baku ekstrak yang berkualitas, pengujian khasiat, dan keamanan pembuatan produk akhir, hingga inovasi produk dengan teknologi yang lebih baik.

Dengan 2 konsep inovasi yang dilakukan yakni konsep Proses pembibitan sampai ke pengguna dan konsep kolaborasi 4 komponen: Academic, Business, Government, dan Community (ABGC), kami memiliki keunggulan dalam hal kualitas yang terkontrol, teruji berdaya manfaat serta berdampak luas. Dalam usaha meningkatkan kemandirian pengadaan bahan baku yang berkualitas unggul, obat herbal kami memiliki konsep proses pembibitan sampai ke pengguna dimana setiap tahapan proses dikontrol dengan ketat.

Kami melakukan penerapan teknologi ramah lingkungan dalam melakukan proses bisnis kami. Penerapan teknologi ramah lingkungan yang diterapkan antara lain dengan memaksimalkan penggunaan limbah hasil ektraksi untuk menjadi kompos yang digunakan di kebun temulawak SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR) sebagai pupuk organik, dan sejak 2017 SCEHR pun telah tersertifikat organik dari Lembaga Sertifikasi Pertanian Organik.

Inovasi pada proses pengembangan produk dengan teknologi ramah lingkungan mencakup penggunaan media coating berbasis air dan tidak lagi menggunakan media coating berbasis pelarut organik. Implementasi media coating berbasis air tersebut secara menyeluruh pada produk-produk kami mampu mengurangi 100% dampak risiko pencemaran pelarut organik pada lingkungan dan juga risiko paparan pelarut organik pada sumber daya manusia kami.

Continuous innovation in the production process involves the application of environmentally friendly technology wherein the herbal extraction process is carried out with environmentally friendly solvents (not organic solvents) and the application of solvent recovery and reuse. It was able to reduce the use and waste of solvents by more than 25%.

Innovation in marketing and sales processes is carried out by utilizing technology, information and communication. The use of digital selling and store information and promotion also plays a role in increasing the effectiveness of the marketing process and growing our product sales. After-sales service is also carried out by utilizing technology, information and communication through various available media such as online media, social media and print media.

SOHO Global Health also implements a Continuous Improvement program where every individual can innovate and make contributions which have positive impact on the continuity of the company's business processes. The implementation of the Continuous Improvement program has also become a solid basis for SOHO to continue to innovate in various aspects related to technology, environment, finance and society.

## Product Information

We subject our products to series of test and assessment, including obtaining permits and approvals from regulators before releasing products to the public. All product packaging have clear information about our products which includes: (a) Product content; (b) Effects and possible side effects of the product; (c) Proper storage and handling. These information are important since each person have different reaction to substances.

Our products are mainly supplements, thus there is minimal to no adverse impact in consuming our products. None the less we are being transparent and providing the necessary information to our consumers.

Inovasi berkesinambungan pada proses produksi melibatkan penerapan teknologi ramah lingkungan dimana untuk proses ekstraksi herbal digunakan pelarut yang ramah lingkungan (bukan pelarut organik) dan juga penerapan pemulihan dan penggunaan kembali pelarut. Hal tersebut mampu mengurangi pemakaian dan limbah pelarut lebih dari 25%.

Inovasi pada proses pemasaran dan penjualan dilakukan dengan memanfaatkan teknologi, informasi, dan komunikasi. Pemanfaatan penjualan dan informasi promosi toko digital juga ikut berperan dalam meningkatkan efektivitas proses pemasaran dan pertumbuhan penjualan produk-produk kami. Pelayanan purna jual juga dilakukan dengan memanfaatkan teknologi, informasi dan komunikasi melalui berbagai media yang tersedia seperti media online, media sosial, dan media cetak.

SOHO Global Health juga menerapkan program peningkatan keberlanjutan dimana setiap individu dapat berinovasi dan berkontribusi yang memberikan dampak positif bagi kelangsungan proses bisnis perusahaan. Penerapan program peningkatan keberlanjutan pun menjadi dasar yang kokoh bagi SOHO untuk terus berinovasi pada berbagai aspek terkait teknologi, lingkungan, finansial, dan kemasyarakatan.

## Informasi Produk

Kami membuat produk kami melalui serangkaian pengujian dan penilaian, termasuk memperoleh izin dan persetujuan dari regulator sebelum merilis produk ke publik. Semua kemasan produk memiliki informasi yang jelas tentang produk kami yang meliputi: (a) Konten produk; (b) Efek dan kemungkinan efek samping produk; (c) Penyimpanan dan penanganan yang tepat. Informasi ini penting karena setiap orang memiliki reaksi yang berbeda terhadap suatu zat.

Produk kami sebagian besar adalah suplemen, sehingga minimal atau tidak ada dampak buruk dalam mengonsumsi produk kami. Meskipun demikian, kami bersikap transparan dan memberikan informasi yang diperlukan kepada konsumen kami.

## Impairment assessment of trade receivables

### Description of the key audit matter:

As of December 31, 2023, the Group recognized trade receivables amounting to Rp1.5 trillion or 31% of consolidated total assets. As described in Notes 2, 3 and 5 to the accompanying consolidated financial statements, the Group applied the simplified approach in calculating expected credit losses ("ECL") of trade receivables based on a provision matrix in accordance with historical credit loss experience, aging analysis of trade receivables and adjusted for forward-looking information specific to the debtors and the economic environment. This impairment assessment of trade receivables is a key audit matter for us as it required an exercise of significant management judgment, and its amount is material as described above.

Berdasarkan Akta Notaris yang dibuat di hadapan Notaris Jimmy Tanal, S.H., M.Kn., No.176 tanggal 26 Oktober 2020 mengenai telah dilaksanakannya pencatatan saham-saham Perusahaan pada Bursa Efek Indonesia (“BEI”) yang menyebabkan perubahan jumlah modal ditempatkan dan disetor Perusahaan sejumlah 1.269.168.239 saham, dengan nilai nominal seluruhnya sebesar Rp634.584. d. Prinsip-prinsip konsolidasi

Laporan keuangan konsolidasian meliputi laporan keuangan Perusahaan dan entitas-entitas anak. Kendali diperoleh bila Kelompok Usaha terekspos atau memiliki hak atas imbal hasil variabel dari keterlibatannya dengan investee dan memiliki kemampuan untuk mempengaruhi imbal hasil tersebut melalui kekuasaannya atas investee. Dengan demikian, investor mengendalikan investee jika dan hanya jika investor memiliki seluruh hal berikut ini:

i) Kekuasaan atas investee, yaitu hak yang ada saat ini yang memberi investor kemampuan kini untuk mengarahkan aktivitas relevan dari investee,
ii) Eksposur atau hak atas imbal hasil variabel dari keterlibatannya dengan investee, dan
iii) Kemampuan untuk menggunakan kekuasaannya atas investee untuk mempengaruhi jumlah imbal hasil.

Bila Kelompok Usaha tidak memiliki hak suara atau hak serupa secara mayoritas atas suatu investee, Kelompok Usaha mempertimbangkan semua fakta dan keadaan yang relevan dalam mengevaluasi apakah mereka memiliki kekuasaan atas investee, termasuk:

i) Pengaturan kontraktual dengan pemilik hak suara lainnya dari investee,
ii) Hak yang timbul atas pengaturan kontraktual lain, dan
iii) Hak suara dan hak suara potensial yang dimiliki Kelompok Usaha.

Kelompok Usaha menilai kembali apakah mereka mengendalikan investee bila fakta dan keadaan mengindikasikan adanya perubahan terhadap satu atau lebih dari ketiga elemen dari pengendalian. Konsolidasi atas entitas-entitas anak dimulai sejak Kelompok Usaha memperoleh pengendalian atas entitas anak dan berakhir pada saat Kelompok Usaha kehilangan pengendalian atas entitas anak. Aset, liabilitas, penghasilan dan beban dari entitas anak yang diakuisisi pada tahun tertentu disertakan dalam laporan keuangan konsolidasian sejak tanggal Kelompok Usaha memperoleh kendali sampai tanggal Kelompok usaha tidak lagi mengendalikan entitas anak tersebut.

d. Principles of consolidation

The consolidated financial statements comprise the financial statements of the Company and its subsidiaries. Control is achieved when the Group is exposed, or has rights, to variable returns from its involvement with the investee and has the ability to affect those returns through its power over the investee. Thus, the Group controls an investee if and only if the Group has all of the following:

i) Power over the investee, that is existing rights that give the Group current ability to direct the relevant activities of the investee,
ii) Exposure, or rights, to variable returns from its involvement with the investee, and
iii) The ability to use its power over the investee to affect its returns.

When the Group has less than a majority of the voting or similar rights of an investee, the Group considers all relevant facts and circumstances in assessing whether it has power over an investee, including:

i) The contractual arrangement with the other vote holders of the investee,
ii) Rights arising from other contractual arrangements, and
iii) The Group's voting rights and potential voting rights.

The Group re-assesses whether or not it controls an investee if facts and circumstances indicate that there are changes to one or more of the three elements of control. Consolidation of a subsidiary begins when the Group obtains control over the subsidiary and ceases when the Group loses control of the subsidiary. Assets, liabilities, income and expenses of a subsidiary acquired during the year are included in the consolidated financial statements from the date the Group gains control until the date the Group ceases to control the subsidiary.

f. Restructuring of entities under common control

Under PSAK 38, "Accounting for Restructuring Under Common Control Entities", transfer of business within entities under common control does not result in a change of the economic substance of ownership of the business being transferred and would not result in a gain or loss to the Group or to the individual entity within the Group. In applying the pooling-of-interests method, the components of the financial statements or the period during which the restructuring occurred and for other periods presented, for comparison purposes, are presented in such a manner as if the restructuring has already happened since the beginning of the periods during which the entities were under common control.

h. Pengukuran nilai wajar

Kelompok Usaha mengukur aset keuangan dan liabilitas keuangan, pada nilai wajar setiap tanggal pelaporan. h. Fair value measurement

The Group measures financial assets and financial liabilities, at fair value at each reporting date. The Group also initially measures financial instruments, and assets and liabilities of the acquirees upon business combinations at fair value. They also measure certain recoverable amounts of the Cash-generating Units (“CGU”) using fair value less cost of disposal (“FVLCD”) and certain financial assets at Fair Value through Other Comprehensive Income (“FVOCI”).

Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date. The fair value measurement is based on the presumption that the transaction to sell the asset or transfer the liability takes place either:

i) In the principal market for the asset or liability, or
ii) In the absence of a principal market, in the most advantageous market for the asset or liability.

The principal or the most advantageous market must be accessible to by the Group.

h. Pengukuran nilai wajar (lanjutan)

Nilai wajar dari aset atau liabilitas diukur dengan menggunakan asumsi yang akan digunakan pelaku pasar ketika menentukan harga aset atau liabilitas tersebut, dengan asumsi bahwa pelaku pasar bertindak dalam kepentingan ekonomi terbaiknya.

Pengukuran nilai wajar dari suatu aset nonkeuangan memperhitungkan kemampuan pelaku pasar untuk menghasilkan manfaat ekonomik dengan menggunakan aset dalam penggunaan tertinggi dan terbaiknya atau dengan menjualnya kepada pelaku pasar lain yang akan menggunakan aset tersebut pada penggunaan tertinggi dan terbaiknya.

Kelompok Usaha menggunakan teknik penilaian yang sesuai dengan keadaan dan data yang memadai tersedia untuk mengukur nilai wajar, dengan memaksimalkan masukan (input) yang dapat diamati (observable) yang relevan dan meminimalkan masukan (input) yang tidak dapat diamati (unobservable).

Semua aset dan liabilitas yang nilai wajarnya diukur atau diungkapkan dalam laporan keuangan konsolidasian dikategorikan dalam hierarki nilai wajar berdasarkan level masukan (input) paling rendah yang signifikan terhadap pengukuran nilai wajar secara keseluruhan sebagai berikut:

i) Level 1 - Harga kuotasian (tanpa penyesuaian) di pasar aktif untuk aset atau liabilitas yang identik yang dapat diakses entitas pada tanggal pengukuran.
ii) Level 2 - Teknik penilaian yang menggunakan tingkat masukan (input) yang paling rendah yang signifikan terhadap pengukuran nilai wajar yang dapat diamati (observable) baik secara langsung atau tidak langsung.
iii) Level 3 - Teknik penilaian yang menggunakan tingkat masukan (input) yang paling rendah yang signifikan terhadap pengukuran nilai wajar yang tidak dapat diamati (unobservable).

h. Fair value measurement (continued)

The fair value of an asset or a liability is measured using the assumptions that market participants would use when pricing the asset or liability, assuming that market participants act in their economic best interest.

A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into account a market participant's ability to generate economic benefits by using the asset in its highest and best use or by selling it to another market participant that would use the asset in its highest and best use.

The Group uses valuation techniques that are appropriate in the circumstances and for which sufficient data are available to measure fair value, maximizing the use of relevant observable inputs and minimizing the use of unobservable inputs.

All assets and liabilities for which fair value is measured or disclosed in the consolidated financial statements are categorized within the fair value hierarchy, described as follows, based on the lowest level input that is significant to the fair value measurement as a whole:

i) Level 1 - Quoted (unadjusted) market prices in active markets for identical assets or liabilities.
ii) Level 2 - Valuation techniques for which the lowest level input that is significant to the fair value measurement is directly or indirectly observable.
iii) Level 3 - Valuation techniques for which the lowest level input that is significant to the fair value measurement is unobservable.

Group as a lessee

The Group applies a single recognition and measurement approach for all leases, except for short-term leases and leases of low-value assets. The Group recognizes lease liabilities to make lease payments and right of use assets representing the right to use the underlying assets.

i) Right of use assets

The Group recognizes right of use assets at the commencement date of the lease (i.e., the date the underlying asset is available for use). Right of use assets are measured at cost, less any accumulated depreciation and impairment losses, and adjusted for any remeasurement of lease liabilities. The cost of right of use assets includes the amount of lease liabilities recognized, initial direct costs incurred, and lease payments made at or before the commencement date less any lease incentives received. Right of use assets are depreciated on a straight-line basis over the lease term.

If ownership of the leased asset transfers to the Group at the end of the lease term or the cost reflects the exercise of a purchase option, depreciation is calculated using the estimated useful life of the asset. The right of use assets are also assessed for impairment.

ii) Lease liabilities

At the commencement date of the lease, the Group recognizes lease liabilities measured at the present value of lease payments to be made over the lease term.

ii) Lease liabilities (continued)

The lease payments also include the exercise price of a purchase option reasonably certain to be exercised by the Group and payments of penalties for terminating the lease, if the lease term reflects exercising the option to terminate. Variable lease payments that do not depend on an index or a rate are recognized as expenses in the period in which the event or condition that triggers the payment occurs.

In calculating the present value of lease payments, the Group uses its Incremental Borrowing Rate ("IBR") at the lease commencement date because the interest rate implicit in the lease is not readily determinable. After the commencement date, the amount of lease liabilities is increased to reflect the accretion of interest and reduced for the lease payments made. In addition, the carrying amount of lease liabilities is remeasured if there is a modification, a change in the lease term, a change in the lease payments or a change in the assessment of an option to purchase the underlying asset.

iii) Short-term leases and leases of low-value assets

n. Penurunan nilai aset non-keuangan (lanjutan)

Jumlah terpulihkan yang ditentukan untuk aset individual adalah jumlah yang lebih tinggi antara nilai wajar aset atau UPK dikurangi biaya untuk menjual dengan nilai pakainya, kecuali aset tersebut tidak menghasilkan arus kas masuk yang sebagian besar independen dari aset atau kelompok aset lain. n. Impairment of non-financial assets (continued)

An asset's recoverable amount is the higher of an asset's or CGU's fair value less costs to sell and its value in use, and is determined for an individual asset, unless the asset does not generate cash inflows that are largely independent of those from other assets or groups of assets. Where the carrying amount of an asset or CGU exceeds its recoverable amount, the asset is considered impaired and is written down to its recoverable amount.

The Group bases its impairment calculation on detailed budgets and forecast calculations which are prepared separately for each of the Group's CGUs to which the individual assets are allocated. These budgets and forecast calculations are generally covering a period of five or ten years in accordance with the stability of each estate's cash flows. Beyond the forecasted period, the estimated cash flows are determined by extrapolating the forecasted cash flows using a steady long term growth rate.

In assessing the value in use, the estimated net future cash flows are discounted to their present value using a pre-tax discount rate that reflects current market assessments of the time value of money and the risks specific to the asset. In determining fair value less costs to sell, recent market transactions are taken into account, if available. If no such transactions can be identified, an appropriate valuation model is used to determine the fair value of the assets. These calculations are corroborated by valuation multiples or other available fair value indicators.
